10th-regiment-of-foot.png.name: 10Th Regiment Of Foot
10th-regiment-of-foot.png.ability_1_desc: If none of the 10th Regiment of Foot move this turn, add 1 die to their attack.
10th-regiment-of-foot.png.ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, a Soldier in the 10th Regiment of Foot adds 1 to his defense dice.
10th-regiment-of-foot.png.ability_3_desc: When rolling attack dice against an adjacent figure, a Soldier in the 10th Regiment of Foot adds 1 to his attack dice. A Soldier in the 10th Regiment of Foot can only use Bayonet Attack if he moved at least one space this turn.

4th-massachusetts-line.png.name: 4th Massachusetts Line
4th-massachusetts-line.png.ability_1_desc: If none of the 4th Massachusetts Line move this turn, add 1 die to their attack.
4th-massachusetts-line.png.ability_2_desc: If every Army Card you control has a valiant personality, each soldier in the 4th Massachusetts Line receives 1 additional defense die.

abomination.png.name: Abomination
abomination.png.ability_1_desc: Instead of his normal move, Abomination may Super Leap. Super Leap has a move of 10. When counting spaces for Abomination's Super Leap movement, ignore elevations. Abomination may leap over water without stopping, leap over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. Abomination may not leap more than 50 levels up or down in a single leap. If Abomination is engaged when he starts to leap, he will take any leaving engagement attacks. Abomination rolls 3 less attack dice on any turn that he chooses to Super Leap.
abomination.png.ability_2_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Any figure adjacent to Abomination is affected by the Stomp Special Attack. Roll 3 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense separately. Abomination cannot attack using his Stomp Special Attack on the same turn he uses Super Leap.

acolarh-prototype.png.name: Acolarh
acolarh-prototype.png.ability_1_title: Leaf Of The Home Tree Aura
acolarh-prototype.png.ability_1_desc: When any Elf you control within 8 clear sight spaces of Acolarh receives enough wounds to be destroyed, you may roll 10 Ullar Valkyrie dice before removing the figure. If you roll at least 3 Ullar symbols, ignore any wounds that figure just received. Acolarh's Leaf of the Home Tree Aura does not affect Acolarh.
acolarh-prototype.png.ability_2_desc: All friendly figures who follow Ullar and start their turn adjacent to Acolarh may move 2 additional spaces.

acolarh.png.name: Acolarh
acolarh.png.ability_1_title: Leaf Of The Home Tree Aura
acolarh.png.ability_1_desc: When any Elf you control within 8 clear sight spaces of Acolarh receives enough wounds to be destroyed, you may roll 10 Ullar Valkyrie dice before removing the figure. If you roll at least 3 Ullar symbols, ignore any wounds that figure just received. Acolarh's Leaf of the Home Tree Aura does not affect Acolarh.
acolarh.png.ability_2_desc: All friendly figures who follow Ullar and start their turn adjacent to Acolarh may move 2 additional spaces.

adelbern-master-png.png.name: Knight Primus Adelbern
adelbern-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking, you may inflict one wound on a Small or Medium Squad figure or a Small or Medium Common Hero adjacent to Knight Primus Adelbern.

admiral-ej-1m.png.name: Admiral Ej-1M
admiral-ej-1m.png.ability_1_desc: After rolling for Initiative, you may move any Order Markers from this card onto any of your Pirate or Captain Army Cards.
admiral-ej-1m.png.ability_2_desc: Range 5. Attack 2 + Special. You may attack up to 4 times with Boarding Party Special Attack. Roll one additional attack die when attacking a figure engaged with a Pirate or Captain you control. After each attack, if that was the first time you attacked the defending figure this turn, you may move one Pirate or Captain figure you control up to 4 spaces. You may not move the same figure more than once in a turn using Boarding Party Special Attack.

agent-carr-aoa-master-png.png.name: Agent Carr
agent-carr-aoa-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Before moving normally, you may choose a figure within 3 clear sight spaces of Agent Carr. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 unrevealed Order Marker at random from the chosen figure's Army Card.
agent-carr-aoa-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Add 4 to Agent Carr's Attack Value when attacking an adjacent figure.
agent-carr-aoa-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: Agent Carr is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

agent-carr.png.name: Agent Carr
agent-carr.png.ability_1_desc: Agent Carr can move through all figures.
agent-carr.png.ability_2_desc: If Agent Carr is attacking an adjacent figure, add 4 dice to Agent Carr's attack.
agent-carr.png.ability_3_desc: Agent Carr is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

agent-skahen.png.name: Agent Skahen
agent-skahen.png.ability_1_desc: When Agent Skahen attacks, she may attack one additional time.
agent-skahen.png.ability_2_desc: When attacking an opponent's figure, if Agent Skahen inflicts one or more wounds, you may move one Tricky figure you control who follows Vydar and is within 8 clear sight spaces of Agent Skahen up to 4 spaces. You cannot use Cover Fire to move Agent Skahen.
agent-skahen.png.ability_3_desc: When Agent Skahen rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, one shield will block all damage.

air-elemental-card.png.name: Air Elemental
air-elemental-card.png.ability_1_desc: When an opponent's small or medium figure moves onto a space within 2 clear sight spaces of an Air Elemental you control, that figure must end its move there. Figures can never move through any figure affected by Swirling Vortex.
air-elemental-card.png.ability_2_desc: Figures that have the Flying or Stealth Flying special power subtract 1 from their defense dice when attacked by an Air Elemental.
air-elemental-card.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for an Air Elemental's movement, ignore elevations. An Air Elemental may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If an Air Elemental is engaged when it starts to fly, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

airborne-elite.png.name: Airborne Elite
airborne-elite.png.ability_1_desc: Range 5. Lob 12. Attack 2. Use this power once per game. Start the game with a grenade marker on this card. Remove the grenade marker to throw grenades. One at a time do the following with each Airborne Elite: Choose a figure to attack. No clear line of sight is needed. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Grenade Special Attack. Roll 2 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
airborne-elite.png.ability_2_desc: Airborne Elite do not start the game on the battlefield. At the start of each round, before you place Order Markers, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher you may place all 4 Airborne Elite figures on any empty spaces. You cannot place them adjacent to each other or other figures, or on glyphs.

alastair-macdirk.png.name: Alastair Macdirk
alastair-macdirk.png.ability_1_desc: After taking a turn with Alastair MacDirk, you may place a wound marker on Alastair MacDirk and take another turn with him. You may only use this power once during a round.

ana-karithon.png.name: Ana Karithon
ana-karithon.png.ability_1_desc:
Range 4. Attack 4.
Turn Undead Special Attack can be used to attack only Undead figures.
ana-karithon.png.ability_2_desc: All small or medium figures you control within 3 clear sight spaces of Ana Karithon add 1 to their defense dice when rolling defense against an attack from a figure who follows Utgar. Ana Karithon's Protection from Evil Aura does not affect Ana Karithon.
ana-karithon.png.ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on a wounded small or medium Hero figure you control that is adjacent to Ana Karithon, and before using any other special powers on any Army Card or Glyph, you may first roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-12, nothing happens. If you roll a 13 or higher, remove up to 2 wound markers from that Hero's Army Card.

anubian-wolves.png.name: Anubian Wolves
anubian-wolves.png.ability_1_desc: Before moving, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1, choose an Anubian Wolf you control and destroy it. If you roll a 2-6, add 1 to the attack value of this card. If you roll a 7-11, add 2 to the attack value of this card. If you roll a 12-15, add 3 to the attack value of this card. If you roll a 16-19, add 4 to the attack value of this card. If you roll a 20, add 8 to the attack value of this card.

arkmer.png.name: Arkmer
arkmer.png.ability_1_desc: When defending with Arkmer, add as many defense dice as the number of Elves you control adjacent to Arkmer.
arkmer.png.ability_2_desc: If an opponent's small or medium figure moves adjacent to Arkmer, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, the opponent's figure receives one wound. Figures may be targeted only as they move into engagement with Arkmer.

armoc-vipers.png.name: Armoc Vipers
armoc-vipers.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Armoc Vipers, you may first take a turn with any Warlord you control who follows Ullar.
armoc-vipers.png.ability_2_desc: Armoc Vipers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.

arrow-gruts.png.name: Arrow Gruts
arrow-gruts.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Arrow Gruts, you may first take a turn with any Beast you control.
arrow-gruts.png.ability_2_desc: Arrow Gruts are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

ashigaru-harquebus.png.name: Ashigaru Harquebus
ashigaru-harquebus.png.ability_1_desc: If none of the Ashigaru Harquebus move this turn, add 1 die to their attack.

ashigaru-yari.png.name: Ashigaru Yari
ashigaru-yari.png.ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 6. If 3 Ashigaru Yari you control are adjacent to the same enemy figure, they may roll their attack dice as one combined attack. The defending figure compares height to the lowest Ashgaru Yari to determine any height advantage. If Encircle Special Attack is used, the 4th figure that moved this turn cannot attack.

atlaga.png.name: Atlaga the Kyrie Warrior
atlaga.png.ability_1_desc: All Kyrie you control, except Atlaga, move one additional space.
atlaga.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Atlaga, you may choose any opponent's figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Atlaga. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1–15, nothing happens. If you roll a 16 or higher, the chosen figure is destroyed. Atlaga may attempt to use this power only once per game.
atlaga.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Atlaga's movement, ignore elevations. Atlaga may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Atlaga starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

aubrien-archers.png.name: Aubrien Archers
aubrien-archers.png.ability_1_desc: After you take a turn with Aubrien Archers, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may take another turn with Aubrien Archers.

black-wyrmling-card.png.name: Black Wyrmling
black-wyrmling-card.png.ability_1_desc: Instead of attacking with a Black Wyrmling, you may choose one small or medium figure within 4 clear sight spaces of it. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1–10, nothing happens. If you roll an 11–15, the chosen figure receives 1 wound. If you roll a 16 or higher, the chosen figure receives 2 wounds.
black-wyrmling-card.png.ability_2_desc: After revealing an order marker on a Black Wyrmling Army Card, before taking that Black Wyrmling's turn, you may take a turn with one other Wyrmling you control.
black-wyrmling-card.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for a Black Wyrmling's movement, ignore elevations. A Black Wyrmling may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a Black Wyrmling is engaged when it starts to fly, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

blade-gruts.png.name: Blade Gruts
blade-gruts.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Blade Gruts, you may first take a turn with any Orc Champion you control.
blade-gruts.png.ability_2_desc: Blade Gruts are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

blastatrons.png.name: Blastatrons
blastatrons.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Blastatrons, you may move 4 Gladiatrons you control up to 5 spaces each.
blastatrons.png.ability_2_desc: When attacking a non-adjacent figure, add 1 attack die for every Soulborg who follows Vydar that is adjacent to the defending figure.

blue-wyrmling-card.png.name: Blue Wyrmling
blue-wyrmling-card.png.ability_1_desc: Range 4 + Special. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose one other figure within 3 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure to be affected by Fledgling Lightning Breath Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for both figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Fledgling Lightning Breath Special Attack does not affect destructible objects.
blue-wyrmling-card.png.ability_2_desc: After revealing an order marker on a Blue Wyrmling Army Card, before taking that Blue Wyrmling's turn, you may take a turn with one other Wyrmling you control.
blue-wyrmling-card.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for a Blue Wyrmling's movement, ignore elevations. A Blue Wyrmling may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a Blue Wyrmling is engaged when it starts to fly, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

bok-bur-na.png.name: Bok-Bur-Na
bok-bur-na.png.ability_1_desc: Small and Medium figures within 3 clear sight spaces of Bok-Bur-Na reduce their Defense Value by 1 when attacked by a Captain or Pirate you control.
bok-bur-na.png.ability_2_desc: After attacking with Bok-Bur-Na, you may attack an adjacent figure 1 additional time. Bok-Bur-Na's Attack Value is increased by 2 for the second attack.
bok-bur-na.png.ability_3_desc: When Bok-Bur-Na destroys an adjacent figure with a normal attack, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 14 or higher, remove one Wound Marker from Bok-Bur-Na. Bok-Bur-Na cannot use Utgar's Cutlass on destructible objects.

brandis-skyhunter.png.name: Brandis Skyhunter
brandis-skyhunter.png.ability_1_desc: If Brandis Skyhunter is attacking a non-adjacent figure that has the Flying or Stealth Flying special power, add 2 dice to Brandis Skyhunter's attack.
brandis-skyhunter.png.ability_2_desc: Each time Brandis Skyhunter destroys an opponent's non-adjacent Unique Hero, you may take another turn with Brandis Skyhunter.

brave-arrow.png.name: Brave Arrow
brave-arrow.png.ability_1_desc: While moving, Brave Arrow may add 2 to his move number. If he does, he cannot attack this turn.
brave-arrow.png.ability_2_desc: All friendly Scouts adjacent to Brave Arrow receive an additional attack die when attacking a figure adjacent to them.
brave-arrow.png.ability_3_desc: If Brave Arrow is targeted and receives one or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and Brave Arrow. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 10 or higher, ignore any wounds Brave Arrow just received.

braxas.png.name: Braxas
braxas.png.ability_1_desc: Instead of attacking, you may choose up to 3 different small or medium figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Braxas. One at a time, roll the 20-sided die for each chosen figure. If the chosen figure is a Squad figure and you roll an 8 or higher, destroy it. If the chosen figure is a Hero figure and you roll a 17 or higher, destroy the chosen Hero.
braxas.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Braxas's movement, ignore elevations. Braxas may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Braxas starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

brunak.png.name: Brunak
brunak.png.ability_1_desc: Before moving Brunak, choose an unengaged friendly small or medium figure adjacent to Brunak. After you move Brunak, place the chosen figure adjacent to Brunak.
brunak.png.ability_2_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. If Brunak's Blood Hungry Special Attack destroys a figure, Brunak may attack again with his Blood Hungry Special Attack. Brunak may continue attacking with his Blood Hungry Special Attack until he does not destroy a figure.
brunak.png.ability_3_desc: Brunak never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage and he does not have to stop in molten lava spaces.

bursting-hive-master-png.png.name: Bursting Hive Soldier
bursting-hive-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: If a Bursting Hive Soldier receives enough wounds to be destroyed by a normal attack or leaving engagement attack, before destroying that Soldier, roll the 20-sided die once for each adjacent figure that is not a Skordyre. If you roll a 9 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound.
bursting-hive-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: A Bursting Hive Soldier rolls 1 additional die when making a leaving engagement attack.

captain-america.png.name: Captain America
captain-america.png.ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 4. When Captain America attacks with his Shield Throw Special Attack, he may attack 2 additional times. He cannot attack the same figure more than once.
captain-america.png.ability_2_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to Captain America add 1 extra die to their attack, and 1 extra die to their defense.
captain-america.png.ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure.

capuan-gladiators.png.name: Capuan Gladiators
capuan-gladiators.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with the Capuan Gladiators, you may first take a turn with any Human Gladiator Hero you control.
capuan-gladiators.png.ability_2_desc: If all of your order markers are on Gladiator Army Cards, you may add 1 to your initiative roll for every order marker on the Capuan Gladiators' Army Card, up to a maximum of +3 for Initiative Advantage.

chain-gruts-master-png.png.name: Chain Gruts
chain-gruts-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Chain Gruts, you may first take a turn with a Champion you control who is an Orc or who follows Volarak.
chain-gruts-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: After rolling attack dice, before defense dice are rolled, you may re-roll 1 die that did not roll a skull.
chain-gruts-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: Figures engaged with 1 or more Chain Gruts cannot make leaving engagement attacks against figures that are not Chain Gruts.

chana-master-png.png.name: Chana the Zenithwing
chana-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: If Chana the Zenithwing is within 5 clear sight spaces of a Wizard that you control, instead of attacking, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 12 or higher, you may remove one Wound Marker from a friendly Wizard or Beast adjacent to Chana.

chardris.png.name: Chardris
chardris.png.ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 2 + Special. When Chardris attacks with Fire Strike Special Attack, add 1 to Chardris' attack dice for every additional Elf Wizard you control within 3 clear sight spaces of Chardris, up to a maximum of + 3 dice.

charos.png.name: Charos
charos.png.ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure.
charos.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Charos's movement, ignore elevation. Charos may fly over water without stopping. Charos may pass over figures without becoming engaged. Charos may fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Charos starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

cobra-commander-advanced-png.png.name: Cobra Commander
cobra-commander-advanced-png.png.ability_1_desc: COBRA Commander adds 1 automatic skull when attacking adjacent figures.
cobra-commander-advanced-png.png.ability_2_desc: After COBRA Commander receives 1 or more wounds from a normal attack and is not destroyed, you may move COBRA Commander up to 2 spaces. He may not end this movement adjacent to an enemy figure. While moving with I'll Get You Next Time, COBRA Commander does not take leaving engagement attacks.

concan-the-kyrie-warrior.png.name: Concan The Kyrie Warrior
concan-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_1_desc: All friendly Knights and Sentinels adjacent to Concan roll an additional attack die and an additional defense die.
concan-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Concan's movement, ignore elevations. Concan may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Concan starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

cornelius-breech-the-derelict-prince.png.name: Cornelius Breech, The Derelict Prince
cornelius-breech-the-derelict-prince.png.ability_1_desc: When Cornelius Breech, the Derelict Prince attacks, if the defending figure was not adjacent to him at the start of this turn, Cornelius adds 2 to his Attack Value during this attack.
cornelius-breech-the-derelict-prince.png.ability_2_desc: After a Unique Captain you control receives a wound or is destroyed, any or all Pirate Squads you control that chose that Captain for The Captain's Way Special Power may choose Cornelius to be their chosen Captain for the rest of the game. If any Squads do, remove all Wound Markers from Cornelius Breech.

crimson-widow-master-png.png.name: Crimson Widow
crimson-widow-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: At the start of the game, you may choose a Unique Squad in your Army. For this game the chosen Squad's class becomes Pirate, replacing the class listed on its Army Card.
crimson-widow-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: While there is an Order Marker on Crimson Widow, all Pirates you control increase their Attack Value by 1 when attacking adjacent figures.
crimson-widow-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: Before taking a turn with Crimson Widow, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to choose up to two Pirates you control within 6 clear sight spaces of Crimson Widow. You may move the chosen Pirates up to 3 spaces each.

crixus.png.name: Crixus
crixus.png.ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice, if Crixus rolls at least one shield, the most wounds Crixus may take for this attack is one.

cyprien-esenwein.png.name: Cyprien Esenwein
cyprien-esenwein.png.ability_1_desc: Each time Cyprien Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Cyprien Esenwein cannot Life Drain destructible objects.
cyprien-esenwein.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking, Cyprien Esenwein may attempt a Chilling Touch. To do this, choose a figure adjacent to Cyprien Esenwein and roll the 20-sided die. • If you roll 1-12, nothing happens. • If you roll 13-15, the chosen figure receives 1 wound. • If you roll 16-17, the chosen figure receives 2 wounds. • If you roll 18-19, the chosen figure receives 3 wounds. • If you roll a 20 or higher, the chosen figure receives 6 wounds. Cyprien Esenwein's Chilling Touch does not affect Soulborgs or destructible objects.
cyprien-esenwein.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Cyprien Esenwein's movement, ignore elevations. Cyprien Esenwein may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Cyprien Esenwein starts to fly, if he is engaged he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

darrak-ambershard.png.name: Darrak Ambershard
darrak-ambershard.png.ability_1_desc: If Darrak Ambershard is attacking an opponent's figure that is adjacent to at least one other figure you control, add 2 dice to Darrak Ambershard's attack.
darrak-ambershard.png.ability_2_desc: When you roll the 20-sided die for a Treasure Glyph trap with Darrak Ambershard, you may add 4 to your die roll.
darrak-ambershard.png.ability_3_desc: If Darrak Ambershard is attacked with a normal attack and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If Darrak Ambershard is on a dungeon space, add 3 to your die roll. If he is on a shadow space, add 6 to your die roll. If you roll a 1–15, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 16 or higher, ignore all damage that would be inflicted by the attack.

deadeye-dan.png.name: Deadeye Dan
deadeye-dan.png.ability_1_desc: Range 10. Attack 1. Choose a non-adjacent small or medium figure to attack. The chosen figure cannot roll defense dice when attacked by Deadeye Dan's Ullar Enhanced Rifle Special Attack. Deadeye Dan may not use this special attack if he moved this turn.
deadeye-dan.png.ability_2_desc: Instead of attacking, you may choose any non-adjacent figure within 10 clear sight spaces of Deadeye Dan. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 19 or 20, the chosen figure is destroyed. If you roll a 1-18, you missed. Deadeye Dan may not use this special power if he moved this turn.

death-chasers-army-card.png.name: Death Chasers Of Thesk
death-chasers-army-card.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with the Death Chasers of Thesk, you may first take a turn with any large wild Hero you control.
death-chasers-army-card.png.ability_2_desc: At the start of the first round of the game, after all order markers have been placed, you may move all Death Chasers of Thesk you control up to 5 spaces each. They must end their Orc Battle Rush movement on an empty space.

death-knights-of-valkrill-card.png.name: Death Knights Of Valkrill
death-knights-of-valkrill-card.png.ability_1_desc: Figures attacked by a Death Knight of Valkrill subtract 2 from their defense dice. Destructible objects are not affected by Soul Weapons.
death-knights-of-valkrill-card.png.ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Death Knights of Valkrill, you may first take a turn with any small, medium, or large relentless Hero you control.

deathreavers-revised.png.name: Deathreavers
deathreavers-revised.png.ability_1_desc: After a Deathreaver you control rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an opponent's figure, you may move any 2 Deathreavers you control up to 4 spaces each.
deathreavers-revised.png.ability_2_desc: Deathreavers are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
deathreavers-revised.png.ability_3_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Deathreavers may double their Height.

deathstalkers.png.name: Deathstalkers
deathstalkers.png.ability_1_desc: When rolling attack dice against a small or medium figure, if a Deathstalker rolls a skull on every die, the defending figure receives a wound for every skull, and cannot roll any defense dice.

deathwalker-7000.png.name: Deathwalker 7000
deathwalker-7000.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and instead of attacking, Deathwalker may choose to self-destruct. Roll the 20-sided die to determine if any other figures are wounded. If you roll a 1-3, all adjacent figures are safe. If you roll a 4-15, each adjacent figure receives 2 wounds. If you roll a 16-19, each adjacent figure receives 4 wounds. If you roll a 20, each adjacent figure receives 8 wounds. After using this power, Deathwalker is always destroyed.
deathwalker-7000.png.ability_2_desc: When Deathwalker 7000 rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, one shield will block all damage.

deathwalker-8000.png.name: Deathwalker 8000
deathwalker-8000.png.ability_1_desc: Range 7. Attack 3. If Deathwalker's Rapid Fire Special Attack inflicts a wound, he may attack again with his Rapid Fire Special Attack. Deathwalker may continue attacking with his Rapid Fire Special Attack until he does not inflict a wound.

deathwalker-9000.png.name: Deathwalker 9000
deathwalker-9000.png.ability_1_desc: Range 7. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Explosion Special Attack. Deathwalker only needs a clear sight shot at the chosen figure. Roll 3 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Deathwalker can be affected by his own Explosion Special Attack.
deathwalker-9000.png.ability_2_desc: Any Soulborg Guards adjacent to Deathwalker add 2 spaces to their range.

decker-master-png.png.name: Decker the Burrowbreaker
decker-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Instead of moving normally with the Decker the Burrowbreaker, you may place him onto an empty non-water space within 4 spaces of Decker that is no higher than 6 levels above or 3 levels below Decker's level. If Decker is engaged when he starts his Underground Movement, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.
decker-master-png.png.ability_2_desc:
Range Special. Attack 4.
Instead of moving and attacking normally with Decker, you may move him up to 5 spaces in a straight line. When moving with Drill-Drive Special Attack, Decker may pass through figures and does not take leaving engagement attacks from figures he passed through. After moving, roll attack dice once for all figures passed through that turn. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Defending figures never have height advantage against Drill-Drive Special Attack.

deepwyrm-drow.png.name: Deepwyrm Drow
deepwyrm-drow.png.ability_1_desc: Each time a Deepwyrm Drow attacks a small, medium, or large Hero with a normal attack or a leaving engagement attack and inflicts at least 1 wound, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1–11, nothing happens. If you roll a 12 or higher, add 1 additional wound to the defending figure.
deepwyrm-drow.png.ability_2_desc: If a Deepwyrm Drow is attacked with a normal attack and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If that Deepwyrm Drow is on a dungeon space, add 3 to your die roll. If it is on a shadow space, add 6 to your die roll. If you roll a 1–15, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 16 or higher, ignore all damage that would be inflicted by the attack.

deflectatron-master-png.png.name: Deflectatron
deflectatron-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Figures with the Orbital Deployment Special Power do not start the game on the battlefield. At the start of a round, before placing Order Markers, you may place 1 Deflectatron that has not entered the battlefield on an empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of a friendly figure. You cannot use more than one Orbital Deployment Special Power each round.
deflectatron-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: A Deflectatron never makes leaving engagement attacks.
deflectatron-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: Figures adjacent to one or more Deflectatrons cannot determine clear sight to any figures. When a figure adjacent to one or more of your Deflectatrons defends against an attack from a non-adjacent figure, change 1 die result that was not a shield to a shield, if possible. Magnetic Deflector Shield is negated while adjacent to another figure with the Magnetic Deflector Shield Special Power.

destro-advanced-png.png.name: Destro
destro-advanced-png.png.ability_1_desc: At the start of the game, you may place up to 2 different Tech Glyphs power-side up onto the Army Cards of up to 2 different Unique Heroes in your Army.
destro-advanced-png.png.ability_2_desc: Destro adds 1 automatic shield to his defense rolls against attacks from non-adjacent figures.
destro-advanced-png.png.ability_3_desc: Once per turn, after making a normal attack, Destro may reduce his Attack Value by 2 and make an additional normal attack.

doctor-doom.png.name: Doctor Doom
doctor-doom.png.ability_1_desc: After taking a turn with Doctor Doom, you may choose any Unique Hero figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Doctor Doom. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, take temporary control of that hero and immediately take a turn with the chosen Hero. At the end of that turn, control of the chosen Hero returns to the player who controlled the Hero before the Mind Exchange. All Order Markers that were on the chosen Hero's card will stay on the card.
doctor-doom.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Doctor Doom's movement, ignore elevations. Doctor Doom may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Doctor Doom starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

dorim-the-bulkhead-brawler.png.name: Dorim The Bulkhead Brawler
dorim-the-bulkhead-brawler.png.ability_1_desc: If Dorim the Bulkhead Brawler attacks an opponent's figure during his turn, the Move Value of all of your Army Cards is increased by 1 until the next time you reveal an Order Marker.
dorim-the-bulkhead-brawler.png.ability_2_desc: After rolling attack dice, before defense dice are rolled, you may re-roll one die that did not roll a skull.

dr-mindbender-advanced-png.png.name: Doctor Mindbender
dr-mindbender-advanced-png.png.ability_1_desc: At the start of Doctor Mindbender's turn, you may move all friendly figures adjacent to Doctor Mindbender up to 3 spaces.
dr-mindbender-advanced-png.png.ability_2_desc: At the end of Doctor Mindbender's turn, you may choose an enemy Unique figure within 3 spaces of Doctor Mindbender and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, after this turn you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on Doctor Mindbender. If you do, take temporary control of the enemy Army Card and take a turn with it. After the turn, control returns to the Army Card's previous owner.

dreadnoughts-of-caraway-cavern-advanced-.name: Dreadnoughts Of Caraway Cavern
dreadnoughts-of-caraway-cavern-advanced-.ability_1_desc: At the start of the game, choose one Unique Captain you control to be the Dreadnoughts of Caraway Cavern's Captain for this game. Dreadnoughts roll one additional defense die against attacks from non-adjacent figures when their chosen Captain is within 4 clear sight spaces.
dreadnoughts-of-caraway-cavern-advanced-.ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Dreadnoughts of Caraway Cavern, you may first take a turn with their chosen Captain or a Pirate Hero you control.
dreadnoughts-of-caraway-cavern-advanced-.ability_3_desc: After attacking an opponent's figure, roll 1 attack die for each wound inflicted in that attack. For each additional skull rolled, inflict 1 wound on that figure.

drow-chainfighter.png.name: Drow Chainfighter
drow-chainfighter.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with a Drow Chainfighter, you may choose one opponent's small or medium figure within 3 clear sight spaces whose base is no more than 6 levels above that Drow Chainfighter's height or 6 levels below that Drow Chainfighter's base. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 9 or higher, place the chosen figure on any empty same-level space adjacent to that Drow Chainfighter. If the chosen figure is engaged when it is moved by Chain Grab, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.
drow-chainfighter.png.ability_2_desc: If a Drow Chainfighter is attacked with a normal attack and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If that Drow Chainfighter is on a dungeon space, add 3 to your die roll. If he is on a shadow space, add 6 to your die roll. If you roll a 1–15, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 16 or higher, ignore all damage that would be inflicted by the attack.

duend.png.name: Dūnd
duend.png.ability_1_desc: Before moving, you may choose a figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Dūnd. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher remove all order markers on the chosen figure's army card (or cards if your opponent has more than one common card for that figure).

duke-advanced-side-png.png.name: Duke
duke-advanced-side-png.png.ability_1_desc: The first time each round you reveal a numbered Order Maker on this Army Card, instead of taking a turn with Duke you may take a turn with up to 2 G.I. JOE or Soldier Heroes you control. Duke can be one of those Heroes.
duke-advanced-side-png.png.ability_2_desc: While Duke has a revealed Order Marker on his Army Card, other G.I. JOE and Soldier figures you control within 2 clear sight spaces of Duke add 1 to their Attack Value.

dumutef-guard.png.name: Dumutef Guard
dumutef-guard.png.ability_1_desc: Add 1 to Dumutef Guard's attack and defense while on a road space.
dumutef-guard.png.ability_2_desc: All friendly Devourers adjacent to a Dumutef Guard receive an additional attack die.

dzu-teh.png.name: Dzu-Teh
dzu-teh.png.ability_1_desc: If a Dzu-Teh is adjacent to a Glacier Mountain, the Dzu-Teh may Glacier Traverse instead of moving normally. You may do this with any or all Dzu-Teh you control each turn. To Glacier Traverse, move to any unoccupied space adjacent to that Glacier Mountain.
dzu-teh.png.ability_2_desc: If a Dzu-Teh is adjacent to a Glacier Mountain, opponents' figures must be adjacent to that Dzu-Teh to attack it with a normal attack.
dzu-teh.png.ability_3_desc: Slippery Ice and Heavy Snow only count as 1 space when moving.

earth-elemental-card.png.name: Earth Elemental
earth-elemental-card.png.ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Any non-flying figure adjacent to this Earth Elemental is affected by Earth Slam Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense separately.
earth-elemental-card.png.ability_2_desc: Instead of moving normally with an Earth Elemental, you may immediately place it on any empty non-water space that is within 4 spaces of that Earth Elemental and is no higher than 1 level above that Earth Elemental's height or 3 levels below that Earth Elemental's base. If an Earth Elemental is engaged when it starts its Underground Movement, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

eldgrim-the-viking-champion.png.name: Eldgrim The Viking Champion
eldgrim-the-viking-champion.png.ability_1_desc: After taking a turn with Eldgrim, you may place a wound marker on Eldgrim and take another turn with him. You may use this power only once during a round.
eldgrim-the-viking-champion.png.ability_2_desc: When Eldgrim is destroyed, you may place this figure on any unique Army Card. Eldgrim's Spirit adds 1 to the move number on that card.

elite-onyx-vipers.png.name: Elite Onyx Vipers
elite-onyx-vipers.png.ability_1_desc: Elite Onyx Vipers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.
elite-onyx-vipers.png.ability_2_desc: After you take a turn with Elite Onyx Vipers, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher you may take another turn with Elite Onyx Vipers.
elite-onyx-vipers.png.ability_3_desc: When an Elite Onyx Viper rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, add 8 defense dice to the defending Viper.

elites-master-png.png.name: Elites Of Ullar
elites-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Unique Ullar Kyrie you control roll 1 additional die when attacking a figure engaged with 1 or more of your Elites of Ullar.
elites-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: If an Elite of Ullar receives a wound from a normal attack by an enemy figure, after that attack you may move 1 unengaged Kyrie figure you control who follows Ullar up to 4 spaces, even if all of your Elites of Ullar are destroyed.

eltahale-card.png.name: Eltahale
eltahale-card.png.ability_1_desc:
Range 1 + Special. Attack 4.
Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose up to two other figures within 2 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure to be affected by Thunder Ram Assault Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. You can only use Thunder Ram Assault Special Attack if Eltahale was not adjacent to the targeted figure at the start of this turn. You cannot use Thunder Ram Assault Special Attack if you used Thunder Step this turn.
eltahale-card.png.ability_2_desc: Instead of moving Eltahale normally, you may choose an opponent's figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Eltahale. Place Eltahale on any empty space adjacent to the chosen figure. For the duration of Eltahale's turn, add 1 to her Attack value. At the end of her turn, roll 1 attack die. If a skull is rolled, place 1 wound marker on Eltahale's Army Card. If Eltahale is engaged when she starts Thunder Step, she will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

emirroon.png.name: Emirroon
emirroon.png.ability_1_desc:
After moving and before attacking, you may roll the 20-sided die. Add the number of Elves you control adjacent to Emirroon to your die roll.
• If you roll 1-4, nothing happens.
• If you roll 5-11, you may place 1 Elf you control adjacent to Emirroon.
• If you roll 12-17, you may place up to 2 Elves you control adjacent to Emirroon.
• If you roll 18-20, you may place up to 3 Elves you control adjacent to Emirroon.
If the summoned Elves are engaged, they will not take any leaving engagement attacks. Emirroon cannot summon an Elf that he is already adjacent to.

empress-kiova.png.name: Empress Kiova
empress-kiova.png.ability_1_desc: When you roll defense dice for any Kyrie that you control who follows Einar and is within 5 clear sight spaces of Empress Kiova, you may re-roll all defense dice that did not show shields. Gift of the Empress Aura can be used only once for each defense roll. Empress Kiova's Gift of the Empress Aura does not affect Empress Kiova.
empress-kiova.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Empress Kiova's movement, ignore elevations. Empress Kiova may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Empress Kiova starts to fly, if she is engaged she will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

erevan-sunshadow.png.name: Erevan Sunshadow
erevan-sunshadow.png.ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack Special. Each time you attack with Erevan Sunshadow's Fire Blast Special Attack, you may choose to roll 2, 3, or 4 attack dice. If a skull is rolled on every die, you may attack again with Erevan Sunshadow's Fire Blast Special Attack. You may continue attacking with Erevan Sunshadow's Fire Blast Special Attack until you do not roll a skull on every die.
erevan-sunshadow.png.ability_2_desc: Once per game, Erevan Sunshadow may use Fey Step. Before moving normally with Erevan Sunshadow, you may place him on any empty space within 5 spaces of his current location. If Erevan Sunshadow is engaged when he uses Fey Step, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

estivara.png.name: Estivara
estivara.png.ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 3. If Estivara inflicts at least 1 wound with Venom Ray Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die for Venom Damage. If you roll a 1–9, the defending figure receives no additional wounds for Venom Damage. If you roll a 10–19, add 1 additional wound marker to the defending figure's Army Card, and roll again for Venom Damage. If you roll a 20, destroy the defending figure.
estivara.png.ability_2_desc: All Arachnid figures you control within 6 clear sight spaces of Estivara roll 1 additional attack die when attacking normally.
estivara.png.ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with Estivara, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, while she remains on that space, Estivara has no visible Hit Zone until the next time you reveal an order marker.

evar-001.png.name: Evar Scarcarver
evar-001.png.ability_1_desc: When Evar Scarcarver attacks an adjacent figure or destructible object, he may attack one additional time.
evar-001.png.ability_2_desc: When revealing a numbered order marker on Evar Scarcarver's Army Card, you may also reveal an "X" order marker that is on Evar Scarcarver's Army Card to activate Frost Rage for the duration of the round. While Frost Rage is active, add 1 to Evar Scarcarver's Attack and Defense values for each wound marker on his Army Card.

ewashia-master-of-tides.png.name: Ewashia, Master Of Tides
ewashia-master-of-tides.png.ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Ewashia, Master of Tides, before taking Ewashia's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.
ewashia-master-of-tides.png.ability_2_desc:
Range 6. Attack 4.
Ewashia may use Twister Special Attack if she is within 1 space of a water tile. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose up to 2 spaces in a straight line from the targeted figure. All figures on those spaces are also affected by Twister Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Ewashia is not affected by Twister Special Attack.
ewashia-master-of-tides.png.ability_3_desc: Ewashia does not have to stop her movement when entering a water space. Add 1 to Ewashia's Defense Value while she is on a water space.
ewashia-master-of-tides.png.ability_4_desc: Ewashia starts each game with 3 water tiles on this Army Card. At the end of Ewashia's turn, you may place a water tile from this Army Card on Ewashia's space or within 1 space of Ewashia, if the water tile fits normally onto that space.

exiles-of-the-sundered-sea.png.name: Exiles Of The Sundered Sea
exiles-of-the-sundered-sea.png.ability_1_desc: Start the game with 3 black Powder Markers on this card. After moving and before attacking, you may remove a Powder Marker from this card to add 4 to the Exiles of the Sundered Sea's Range Value for the rest of the turn. You may only use this Special Power once during a round.
exiles-of-the-sundered-sea.png.ability_2_desc: If an Exile of the Sundered Sea you control is attacked by an opponent's figure that is not adjacent and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-12, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 13 or higher, that Exile takes no damage and may immediately move up to 3 spaces.
exiles-of-the-sundered-sea.png.ability_3_desc: Exiles of the Sundered Sea are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

fen-hydra.png.name: Fen Hydra
fen-hydra.png.ability_1_desc: When this Fen Hydra attacks, it may attack up to 4 times. Reduce the number of times this Fen Hydra can attack by 1 for each wound marker on this Army Card.
fen-hydra.png.ability_2_desc: If an opponent's figure is within 2 spaces of this Fen Hydra, and its base is no more than 3 levels above this Fen Hydra's height or 3 levels below this Fen Hydra's base, this Fen Hydra may add 1 to its Range when attacking that figure.
fen-hydra.png.ability_3_desc: The Fen Hydra does not have to stop its movement when entering water spaces.

feral-troll.png.name: Feral Troll
feral-troll.png.ability_1_desc: When attacking with this Feral Troll, it receives 1 extra attack die for each wound marker on the defending figure's Army Card, to a maximum of 3 additional attack dice for Blood Frenzy.
feral-troll.png.ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with this Feral Troll, remove 1 Wound Marker from this Feral Troll's Army Card.

festering-honor-guard-master-png.png.name: Festering Honor Guard
festering-honor-guard-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: For the entire game, if one of your Festering Honor Guard is on a Unique Hero's Army Card at the end of the round, you must roll the 20-sided die for that Hero. If you roll a 17 or higher, destroy that Hero. If a Festering Honor Guard is on a Unique Hero's Army Card when that Hero is destroyed by this Special Power, or by a normal attack, Special Attack, or leaving engagement attack, place that Festering Honor Guard on a space that Hero occupied, if possible.
festering-honor-guard-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: If Queen Maladrix the Conqueror is in your Army, when she is destroyed, you may move any unrevealed Order Markers from her Army Card to this Army Card. Festering Honor Guards add 1 to their Attack Value if Queen Maladrix is in your Army and is destroyed.
festering-honor-guard-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, the Festering Honor Guard may double their Height.

fia-bonny.png.name: Fia Bonny The Void Siren
fia-bonny.png.ability_1_desc: Start the game with 3 black Powder Markers on this card. After moving and before attacking, you may remove a Powder Marker from this card to add 4 to Fia Bonny the Void Siren's Range Value for the rest of the turn. You may only use this Special Power once during a round.
fia-bonny.png.ability_2_desc: The first time each turn that Fia Bonny is targeted by a Squad figure with a normal or special attack, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, Fia Bonny cannot be targeted by that attack or any other attack this turn.
fia-bonny.png.ability_3_desc: Fia Bonny is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

finn-the-viking-champion.png.name: Finn The Viking Champion
finn-the-viking-champion.png.ability_1_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to Finn with a range of 1 add 1 die to their normal attack.
finn-the-viking-champion.png.ability_2_desc: When Finn is destroyed, place this figure on any unique Army Card. Finn's Spirit adds 1 to the normal attack number on that card.

fire-elemental-card.png.name: Fire Elemental
fire-elemental-card.png.ability_1_desc: A Fire Elemental never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and it does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.
fire-elemental-card.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to at least one Fire Elemental you control. If you roll a 14 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures with the Lava Resistant special power are not affected by Searing Intensity.
fire-elemental-card.png.ability_3_desc: A Fire Elemental can never roll defense dice while it is on a water space.

frost-giant-card.png.name: Frost Giant Of Morh
frost-giant-card.png.ability_1_desc: If this Frost Giant of Morh begins its turn unengaged, add 2 to its Move value this turn. If it begins its turn engaged, add 2 to its Attack value this turn.
frost-giant-card.png.ability_2_desc: After attacking with this Frost Giant of Morh, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may attack again with this Frost Giant of Morh.
frost-giant-card.png.ability_3_desc: If this Frost Giant of Morh is attacked with a normal attack by an opponent's figure and receives enough wounds to be destroyed, roll 3 attack dice. One at a time for each skull rolled, you may inflict 1 wound on any figure that is adjacent to this Frost Giant of Morh. Figures affected by Dying Swipe cannot roll any defense dice and can receive more than 1 wound each. After using Dying Swipe, remove this Frost Giant of Morh from the battlefield.

frostclaw-paladins.png.name: Frostclaw Paladins
frostclaw-paladins.png.ability_1_desc: Before moving a Frostclaw Paladin, you may add 3 to that figure's Move Value this turn. If you do, subtract 2 from that figure's Attack Value this turn.
frostclaw-paladins.png.ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Frostclaw Paladins, you may take a turn with a Champion you control who follows Jandar.

fyorlag-spiders.png.name: Fyorlag Spiders
fyorlag-spiders.png.ability_1_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Fyorlag Spiders may triple their height.
fyorlag-spiders.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any one small or medium opponent's figure that is engaged with at least three Fyorlag Spiders that you control. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, remove one unrevealed order marker at random from the chosen figure's Army Card (or cards if your opponent has more than one Common Army Card for that figure).
fyorlag-spiders.png.ability_3_desc: Before taking a turn with Fyorlag Spiders, you may first take a turn with any Predator you control.

geistfire-master-png.png.name: Necrotech Geistfire
geistfire-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After taking a turn with a Necrotech Geistfire, if that Geistfire attacked a non-adjacent figure, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1–5, that Geistfire receives 1 wound.

gelryie-master-png.png.name: Gelryie Vanguards
gelryie-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: At the start of each round, after placing Order Markers, you may move each Fierce and Unfathomable figure you control up to 1 space for each of your Order Markers on the Gelryie Vanguards.
gelryie-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: A Gelryie Vanguard adds 2 to its Defense Value when it is on a water space or when it defends against an attack from a figure that has height advantage.
gelryie-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: Gelryie Vanguards do not have to stop their movement when entering a water space.

ghastblade-master-png.png.name: Necrotech Ghastblade
ghastblade-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. If a Necrotech Ghastblade attacks with Wild Spin Special Attack, it must attack all adjacent figures, even ones you are not engaged with. Roll each attack separately.

ghoulgrip-master-png.png.name: Necrotech Ghoulgrip
ghoulgrip-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Small and Medium figures engaged with a Necrotech Ghoulgrip cannot move or be moved by any special power or glyph.
ghoulgrip-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: A Necrotech Ghoulgrip adds 1 to its Defense Value when attacked with a normal attack by an adjacent figure.

girushia-master-png.png.name: Girushia, Grove Keeper
girushia-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Girushia, Grove Keeper, before taking Girushia's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.
girushia-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: If an enemy Small or Medium figure moves adjacent to Girushia on a space where that figure could end its movement, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 10 or higher, the figure ends its movement and lowers its Attack Value by 1 until the end of the current turn. If you roll an 18 or higher, the figure also suffers one wound.
girushia-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: If an enemy figure is within 2 spaces of Girushia, and its level is no more than 9 levels above or 3 levels below Girushia's level, Girushia may add 1 to his Range Value when attacking that figure.
girushia-master-png.png.ability_4_desc: At the end of a round, if Girushia is next to a tree or bush, you may remove one Wound Marker from this Army Card.

gladiatrons.png.name: Gladiatrons
gladiatrons.png.ability_1_desc: All small or medium opponent's figures that enter or occupy a space adjacent to any Gladiatron may not move. Figures affected by the Cyberclaw cannot be moved by any special power on an Army Card or Glyph.
gladiatrons.png.ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, a Gladiatron adds 1 die.

glinerva-the-kyrie-warrior.png.name: Glinerva The Kyrie Warrior
glinerva-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_1_desc: When you reveal an Order Marker, you may also reveal the "X" Order Marker on Glinerva the Kyrie Warrior to activate Hanwi's Darkness. Until you next reveal an Order Marker, Glinerva and all Small, Medium, and Large figures within 5 spaces of her cannot target or be targeted by non-adjacent figures with a normal or special attack.
glinerva-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_2_desc: If Glinerva is targeted and receives one or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and Glinerva. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 17 or higher, ignore any wounds Glinerva just received.

goblin-cutters-card.png.name: Goblin Cutters
goblin-cutters-card.png.ability_1_desc: When attacking with a Goblin Cutter you control, if the defending figure is engaged with at least 2 other Goblin Cutters you control, it subtracts 2 from its defense dice.
goblin-cutters-card.png.ability_2_desc: When a Goblin Cutter you control is destroyed by a normal attack from an opponent's figure, you may move any 2 Goblin Cutters you control up to 4 spaces each, and all Goblin Cutters you control no longer have any visible Hit Zones for the duration of the attacking figure's turn while they remain un-engaged. Goblin Cutters will never take any leaving engagement attacks while using Scurry.
goblin-cutters-card.png.ability_3_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Goblin Cutters may add 2 to their height.

golem-card.png.name: Iron Golem
golem-card.png.ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a special attack, this Iron Golem always adds 2 automatic shields to whatever is rolled.
golem-card.png.ability_2_desc: This Iron Golem never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and it does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.

gorillinators.png.name: Gorillinators
gorillinators.png.ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, Gorillinators always add one automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

granite-guardians.png.name: Granite Guardians
granite-guardians.png.ability_1_desc: If a Granite Guardian has a height advantage on an opponent's figure, it may add 2 to its range when attacking that figure.
granite-guardians.png.ability_2_desc: A Granite Guardian with a height advantage on an adjacent opponent's figure rolls an additional attack die when attacking that figure.
granite-guardians.png.ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with Granite Guardians, you may move each Granite Guardian you control up to 1 space. This space may be up to 4 levels higher.

grave-grim-master-png.png.name: Grave Grim
grave-grim-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with a Grave Grim, you may move up to 6 Small, Medium, or Large Undead or Eisenek figures you control up to 3 spaces each.
grave-grim-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: When an opponent rolls the 20-sided die for a Special Power on one of their Army Cards, if one or more of that Army Card's figures are within 3 spaces of a figure you control with the Harrowing Presence special power, they must subtract 3 from the roll.

greatbow-master-png.png.name: Greatbow Archers
greatbow-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: When a Greatbow Archer that has not moved this turn attacks a figure at Range 4 or greater, add 1 to her Attack Value. If the target figure is at Range 7 or greater, instead add 2 to her Attack Value.

greater-ice-elemental-card.png.name: Greater Ice Elemental
greater-ice-elemental-card.png.ability_1_desc: While a Greater Ice Elemental is on a water or ice space, that space and all same-level water spaces adjacent to that Greater Ice Elemental are considered normal ice spaces. Figures do not have to stop their movement on normal ice spaces.
greater-ice-elemental-card.png.ability_2_desc: If an opponent's figure moves adjacent to this Greater Ice Elemental, roll the 20-sided die. If this Greater Ice Elemental is on at least one ice or snow space, add 2 to your die roll. If you roll a 15 or higher, the opponent's figure receives 1 wound. Figures can be affected by Ice Spikes only as they move into engagement with this Greater Ice Elemental.
greater-ice-elemental-card.png.ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with this Greater Ice Elemental, if it is on at least one snow or ice space, remove 1 wound marker from this Greater Ice Elemental's Army Card.

greater-ice-elemental.png.name: Greater Ice Elemental
greater-ice-elemental.png.ability_1_desc: While a Greater Ice Elemental is on a water or ice space, that space and all same-level water spaces adjacent to that Greater Ice Elemental are considered normal ice spaces. Figures do not have to stop their movement on normal ice spaces.
greater-ice-elemental.png.ability_2_desc: If an opponent's figure moves adjacent to this Greater Ice Elemental, roll the 20-sided die. If this Greater Ice Elemental is on at least one ice or snow space, add 2 to your die roll. If you roll a 15 or higher, the opponent's figure receives 1 wound. Figures can be affected by Ice Spikes only as they move into engagement with this Greater Ice Elemental.
greater-ice-elemental.png.ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with this Greater Ice Elemental, if it is on at least one snow or ice space, remove 1 wound marker from this Greater Ice Elemental's Army Card.

greenscale-warriors.png.name: Greenscale Warriors
greenscale-warriors.png.ability_1_desc: At the start of the game, choose a Unique Lizardfolk Hero you control, or a Unique large or huge Dragon Hero you control, to be the Greenscale Warriors' Lizard King. A Greenscale Warrior rolls 1 additional attack and defense die when its chosen Lizard King is within 2 clear sight spaces. You can choose only one Lizard King for all the Greenscale Warriors you control.
greenscale-warriors.png.ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Greenscale Warriors, you may first take a turn with their chosen Lizard King if it is still under your control.

greenshirts-advanced-png.png.name: Greenshirts
greenshirts-advanced-png.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Greenshirts, you may move up to 2 unengaged G.I. JOE or Soldier Heroes you control up to 2 spaces.

grimnak.png.name: Grimnak
grimnak.png.ability_1_desc: Before attacking, choose one medium or small figure adjacent to Grimnak. If the chosen figure is a Squad figure, destroy it. If the chosen figure is a Hero figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, destroy the chosen Hero.
grimnak.png.ability_2_desc: All friendly Orc Warriors adjacent to Grimnak roll an additional attack die and an additional defense die.

grok-riders.png.name: Grok Riders
grok-riders.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Grok Riders, you may first take a turn with any Marro Warlord you control.
grok-riders.png.ability_2_desc: When attacking a figure that is adjacent to any Marro Warlord you control, Grok Riders add 2 to their attack dice.
grok-riders.png.ability_3_desc: Marro Hive cannot rebirth Grok Riders with its Marro Rebirth special power.

guilty-mccreech.png.name: Guilty Mc Creech
guilty-mccreech.png.ability_1_desc: When Guilty Mc Creech attacks, he may attack one additional time.

gurei-oni.png.name: Gurei-Oni
gurei-oni.png.ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure.
gurei-oni.png.ability_2_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose one figure adjacent to the targeted figure to be affected by the Tetsubo Special Attack as well. Roll attack dice once for both figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.

haluchott-master-png.png.name: Haluchott, Corruptor Of Beasts
haluchott-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Haluchott, Corruptor of Beasts, before taking Haluchott's turn, you may take a turn with up to two Small, Medium, or Large Beasts you control.
haluchott-master-png.png.ability_2_title: Staff Of The Long Hand Special Attack
haluchott-master-png.png.ability_2_desc:
Range 6. Attack 2.
You may use the Staff of the Long Hand Special Attack before or after using Haluchott's normal attack.
haluchott-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: While defending against an attack from a Beast, Haluchott increases her Defense Value by 2.

halushia-master-png.png.name: Halushia, Scion Of The Wild
halushia-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Halushia, Scion of the Wild, before taking Halushia's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.
halushia-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Figures adjacent to a tree or bush roll one fewer Combat Die when defending against Halushia's attacks.
halushia-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Instead of moving and attacking normally with Halushia, you may move him up to 4 spaces. Halushia can attack up to 3 times with Ride-By Special Attack at any point before, during, or after this move as long as he is on a space where he can end his movement. Halushia cannot attack the same figure more than once in a single turn with Ride-By Special Attack. When using Ride-By Special Attack, Halushia is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

hatamoto-taro-prototype.png.name: Hatamoto Taro
hatamoto-taro-prototype.png.ability_1_desc: When defending with any Samurai and Ashigaru figures you control within 8 clear sight spaces of Hatamoto Taro, you may roll Einar Valkyrie dice. Each Einar symbol rolled counts as an additional shield. Inspired Defense Aura does not affect Hatamoto Taro.
hatamoto-taro-prototype.png.ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice for Hatamoto Taro, if Hatamoto Taro is adjacent to at least one figure who follows Einar that you control, add one automatic shield to the defense roll.

hatamoto-taro.png.name: Hatamoto Taro
hatamoto-taro.png.ability_1_desc: When defending against a normal attack by an adjacent figure with any Samurai or Ashigaru figures you control within 8 clear sight spaces of Hatamoto Taro, you may roll Einar Valkyrie dice. Each Einar symbol rolled counts as an additional shield. Heroic Defense Aura does not affect Hatamoto Taro.
hatamoto-taro.png.ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice for Hatamoto Taro, if Hatamoto Taro is adjacent to at least one figure you control who follows Einar, add one automatic shield to the defense roll.

heavy-gruts.png.name: Heavy Gruts
heavy-gruts.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Heavy Gruts, you may first take a turn with any Orc Champion you control.
heavy-gruts.png.ability_2_desc: Heavy Gruts are never attacked when leaving engagements.

heirloom.png.name: Heirloom
heirloom.png.ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 3. Choose an opponent's figure to attack. Each opponent's figure adjacent to the chosen figure is also affected by Force Orb Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
heirloom.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Heirloom, you may choose a Treasure Glyph on an unoccupied space within 4 spaces of Heirloom. You may move that Treasure Glyph onto any empty same-level space adjacent to Heirloom. Symbol-side-up Treasure Glyphs cannot be revealed, and power-side-up Treasure Glyphs must be placed power-side up when moved by Mage Hand.
heirloom.png.ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal or special attack, Heirloom always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

hellforge-mandukor-master-png.png.name: Hellforge Mandukor
hellforge-mandukor-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: During Hellforge Mandukor's turn, before moving with it and each time it moves onto a space during this movement, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to Hellforge. If you roll a 15 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures with the Lava Resistant Special Power are not affected by Blast Furnace. Hellforge cannot roll for Blast Furnace against the same figure more than once per turn.
hellforge-mandukor-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: If a figure or destructible object adjacent to Hellforge is destroyed, you may roll the 20-sided die. Add 8 to the roll if the figure is an Eisenek, Soulborg, or destructible object. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may remove a Wound Marker from this card.
hellforge-mandukor-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: At the start of each round after all Order Markers have been placed, if all your Order Markers are placed on Eisenek Army Cards, you may move Hellforge up to 4 spaces. Hellforge must end this movement on an empty space.

heroscape-age-of-annihilation-army-card-.name: Vorid Burrowbreaker
heroscape-age-of-annihilation-army-card-.ability_1_desc: Instead of moving normally with the Vorid Burrowbreaker, you may immediately place him on any empty non-water space that is within 4 spaces of the Burrowbreaker and is no higher than 1 level above the Burrowbreaker's height or 3 levels below the Burrowbreaker's base. If the Burrowbreaker is engaged when he starts his Underground Movement, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.
heroscape-age-of-annihilation-army-card-.ability_2_desc: Range Special. Attack 4. Instead of moving and attacking normally with the Vorid Burrowbreaker, you may move the Burrowbreaker up to 5 spaces in a straight line. When moving with Drill-Drive Special Attack the Burrowbreaker may pass through figures and does not take leaving engagement attacks from figures he passed through. After moving, roll attack dice once for all figures passed through that turn. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Defending figures never have height advantage against Drill-Drive Special Attack.

heroscape-age-of-annihilation-army-card-.name: Admiral Ej-1M
heroscape-age-of-annihilation-army-card-.ability_1_desc: After rolling for initiative, you may move any Order Markers from this card onto any of your Pirate or Captain Army Cards.
heroscape-age-of-annihilation-army-card-.ability_2_desc:
Range 5. Attack 2+ Special.
You may attack up to 4 times with Boarding Party Special Attack. Roll one additional attack die when attacking a figure engaged with a Pirate or Captain you control. After each attack, if that was the first time you attacked the defending figure this turn, you may move one Pirate or Captain figure you control up to 4 spaces. You may not move the same figure more than once in a turn using Boarding Party Special Attack.

heroscape-age-of-annihilation-card-shape.name: Killian Vane III
heroscape-age-of-annihilation-card-shape.ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Blunderbuss Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Killian Vane cannot be affected by his own Blunderbuss Special Attack.

heroscape_sku23_card_master-side-png.png.name: Air Marshal Zed Nesbitt
heroscape_sku23_card_master-side-png.png.ability_1_desc: After Air Marshal Zed Nesbitt finishes moving, if he used the Flying Special Power during this movement, you may choose any number of friendly Small or Medium Vorids that Nesbitt passed over this turn. Place those figures adjacent to Nesbitt. Figures moved with Skyhook never take leaving engagement attacks.
heroscape_sku23_card_master-side-png.png.ability_2_desc:
Range 1. Attack 5.
Nesbitt can only use Crash Landing Special Attack if he used the Flying Special Power this turn. All figures adjacent to Nesbitt are affected by Crash Landing Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. After using Crash Landing Special Attack, you must place one Wound Marker on this Army Card, and Nesbitt cannot move normally for the rest of the round.

hof.png.name: Wynonna Earp
hof.png.ability_1_desc: When placing order markers, if any opponent controls a figure who follows Utgar or Valkrill, you must place a numbered order marker on this card and each opponent must place a numbered order marker on the card of a figure they control who follows Utgar or Valkrill, if possible.
hof.png.ability_2_desc: When attacking a Demon or Undead figure, if Wynonna Earp rolls 2 or more skulls, the defending figure cannot roll defense dice and if destroyed is placed on this card. Destroyed figures on this card cannot be moved by any special power on any Army Card or Glyph.

horned-skull-brutes.png.name: Horned Skull Brutes
horned-skull-brutes.png.ability_1_desc: If a Horned Skull Brute you control is attacked with a normal attack by an opponent's figure and receives 1 or more wounds, you may destroy a small Goblin figure you control that is adjacent to that Horned Skull Brute to ignore any wounds that Horned Skull Brute just received.
horned-skull-brutes.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking, if a Horned Skull Brute you control ends its movement unengaged, you may choose an engaged small or medium friendly Squad figure within 3 clear sight spaces of that Horned Skull Brute whose base is no more than 2 levels higher or lower than the base of that Horned Skull Brute. You may switch that Horned Skull Brute with the chosen Squad figure. Figures moved by Barge into Battle never take any leaving engagement attacks.

ice-troll-251533.png.name: Ice Troll Berserker
ice-troll-251533.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Ice Troll Berserker, roll the 20-sided die. If this Ice Troll Berserker is on a snow or ice space, add 3 to your die roll. If you roll a 13 or higher, you may move this Ice Troll Berserker again.
ice-troll-251533.png.ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with this Ice Troll Berserker, remove 1 wound marker from this Ice Troll Berserker's Army Card. If it is on a snow or ice space, remove 1 additional wound marker.

incredible-hulk.png.name: Incredible Hulk
incredible-hulk.png.ability_1_desc: When Incredible Hulk attacks using a normal attack, he receives one extra attack die for each Wound Marker he has, up to a maximum of 5 extra attack dice for Rage Smash.
incredible-hulk.png.ability_2_desc: Instead of his normal move, Incredible Hulk may Super Leap. Super Leap has a move of 10. When counting spaces for Hulk's Super Leap movement, ignore elevations. Hulk may leap over water without stopping, leap over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. Hulk may not leap more than 50 levels up or down in a single leap. If Hulk is engaged when he starts to leap, he will take any leaving engagement attacks. Hulk rolls 3 less attack dice on any turn that he chooses to Super Leap.
incredible-hulk.png.ability_3_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Any figure adjacent to Incredible Hulk is affected by the Stomp Special Attack. Roll 3 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense separately. Hulk cannot attack using his Stomp Special Attack on the same turn he uses Super Leap.

iron-lich-viscerot-master-png.png.name: Iron Lich Viscerot
iron-lich-viscerot-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Iron Lich Viscerot can move through Small and Medium figures, does not take leaving engagement attacks from Small and Medium figures, and can target and attack non-adjacent figures while only engaged with Small and Medium figures.
iron-lich-viscerot-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Begin the game with 3 yellow Surge Markers on this Army Card. Once per turn, before moving another Eisenek figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Viscerot, you may remove a Surge Marker from this card to add 2 to that figure's Move and Attack Values until the end of the turn.
iron-lich-viscerot-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Viscerot and taking a turn with Viscerot, you may take a turn with another Unique Eisenek Hero or Squad you control.

iron-lich-viscerot.png.name: Iron Lich Viscerot
iron-lich-viscerot.png.ability_1_desc: Iron Lich Viscerot can move through Small and Medium figures, does not take leaving engagement attacks from Small and Medium figures, and can target and attack non-adjacent figures while only engaged with Small and Medium figures.
iron-lich-viscerot.png.ability_2_desc: Begin the game with 3 yellow Surge Markers on this Army Card. Once per turn, before moving another Eisenek figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Viscerot, you may remove a Surge Marker from this card to add 2 to that figure's Move and Attack Values until the end of the turn.
iron-lich-viscerot.png.ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Viscerot and taking a turn with Viscerot, you may take a turn with another Unique Eisenek Hero or Squad you control.

iron-man.png.name: Iron Man
iron-man.png.ability_1_desc: When Iron Man attacks, he may attack one additional time.
iron-man.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Iron Man's movement, ignore elevations. Iron Man may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Iron Man starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

isamu.png.name: Isamu
isamu.png.ability_1_desc: If Isamu is attacked and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die to vanish. If you roll 1-8, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 9 or higher, Isamu takes no damage and may immediately move up to 4 spaces. Isamu can vanish only if he ends his vanishing move not adjacent to any enemy figures.
isamu.png.ability_2_desc: Isamu can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
isamu.png.ability_3_desc: When attacking a figure who follows Jandar, Isamu rolls 2 additional attack dice.

iskra-esenwein.png.name: Iskra Esenwein
iskra-esenwein.png.ability_1_desc: Each time Iskra Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Iskra Esenwein cannot Life Drain destructible objects.
iskra-esenwein.png.ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Iskra Esenwein, you may attempt to summon the Rechets of Bogdan if they are in your army and they have not yet been successfully summoned. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, you must place all 3 Rechets of Bogdan on empty spaces within 6 clear sight spaces of Iskra Esenwein. Any Rechets of Bogdan that you cannot place on the battlefield are immediately destroyed and cannot be summoned again. When the Rechets of Bogdan are summoned, you may immediately take a turn with them.
iskra-esenwein.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Iskra Esenwein's movement, ignore elevations. Iskra Esenwein may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Iskra Esenwein starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

izumi-samurai.png.name: Izumi Samurai
izumi-samurai.png.ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work against other Samurai.

james-murphy.png.name: James Murphy
james-murphy.png.ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Shotgun Blast Special Attack. James only needs a clear sight shot at the chosen figure. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. James cannot be affected by his own Shotgun Blast Special Attack.
james-murphy.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking, choose a small or medium figure adjacent to James. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 12 or higher, the chosen figure cannot roll any defense dice if attacked by James this turn.

jinx-and-kamakura-advanced-png.png.name: Jinx And Kamakura
jinx-and-kamakura-advanced-png.png.ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with this Squad, you may first take a turn with a Ninja Hero you control.
jinx-and-kamakura-advanced-png.png.ability_2_desc: While attacking, roll 1 additional attack die for each other friendly Ninja adjacent to the target.
jinx-and-kamakura-advanced-png.png.ability_3_desc: Members of this Squad can move through all figures and never take leaving engagement attacks.

johnny-quot-shotgun-quot-sullivan.png.name: Johnny "Shotgun" Sullivan
johnny-quot-shotgun-quot-sullivan.png.ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Shotgun Blast Special Attack. Johnny only needs a clear sight shot at the chosen figure. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Johnny cannot be affected by his own Shotgun Blast Special Attack.

jorhdawn.png.name: Jorhdawn
jorhdawn.png.ability_1_desc: Range 7. Attack 1 + Special. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Rain of Flame Special Attack. Add 1 to Jorhdawn's attack dice for every additional Elf Wizard you control within 3 clear sight spaces of Jorhdawn, up to a maximum of + 3 dice. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures.
