Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately. Jorhdawn cannot be affected by her own Rain of Flame Special Attack.

jotun.png.name: Jotun
jotun.png.ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Wild Swing Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Jotun cannot be affected by his own Wild Swing Special Attack.
jotun.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking, choose one small or medium non-flying figure adjacent to Jotun. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, you may throw the figure by placing it on any empty space within 4 spaces of Jotun. The figure must land within clear sight of Jotun. After the figure is placed, roll the 20-sided die for throwing damage. If you roll an 11 or higher, the thrown figure receives 2 wounds. If the figure is thrown onto a level higher than the height of Jotun or onto water, do not roll for throwing damage. The thrown figure does not take any leaving engagement attacks.

kaemon-awa.png.name: Kaemon Awa
kaemon-awa.png.ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 4. When Kaemon Awa attacks with his Quick Release Special Attack, he may attack one additional time.
kaemon-awa.png.ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work against other Samurai.

kato-katsuro.png.name: Kato Katsuro
kato-katsuro.png.ability_1_desc:
Instead of taking a turn with Kato Katsuro, you may take a turn with one of the following that you control:
• 1 Samurai Hero, or
• 1 Samurai Squad, or
• 1 Ashigaru Harquebus Squad and/or 1 Ashigaru Yari Squad. You may choose which Squad to activate first.
Any figure in the above list that is taking a turn instead of Kato Katsuro must be within clear sight of Kato Katsuro before moving.

kayne-master-png.png.name: Imperator Kayne
kayne-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Once during Imperator Kayne's turn, at any point during his normal movement that he is on a space where he could end his movement, you may choose an adjacent Small or Medium figure whose level is no more than 5 levels above Kayne's level and roll the 20-sided die: If you roll 8 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound.

kee-mo-shi.png.name: Kee-Mo-Shi
kee-mo-shi.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any unique figure adjacent to Kee-Mo-Shi. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 19 or 20, take control of the chosen figure and that figure's Army Card. You now control that Army Card and all figures on it. Remove any Order Markers on the chosen figure's Army Card. If Kee-Mo-Shi is destroyed, you retain control of any previously Mind Shackled Army Cards.
kee-mo-shi.png.ability_2_desc: After attacking, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to Kee-Mo-Shi. If you roll a 17 or higher, that figure receives one wound. Soulborgs are not affected by Toxic Skin.

kelda-the-kyrie-warrior.png.name: Kelda The Kyrie Warrior
kelda-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_1_desc:
After moving and before attacking, choose a wounded hero figure adjacent to Kelda. Then roll the 20-sided die to add or remove wound markers from the chosen figure's card:
• If you roll 1, add 2 markers.
• If you roll 2-5, remove 1 marker.
• If you roll 6-17, remove up to 2 markers.
• If you roll 18-20, remove all markers.
kelda-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Kelda's movement, ignore elevations. Kelda may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Kelda starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

khosumet-the-darklord.png.name: Khosumet The Darklord
khosumet-the-darklord.png.ability_1_desc: Each friendly figure adjacent to Khosumet with a relentless personality receives an additional attack die.
khosumet-the-darklord.png.ability_2_desc: You may add 1 to your die roll when you roll for the Unleashed Fury power on any Army Card.

kilkorax-the-kyrie-warrior.png.name: Kilkorax The Kyrie Warrior
kilkorax-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_1_desc:
After moving and before attacking, you may choose up to 2 different Small or Medium enemy figures within 5 clear sight spaces of Kilkorax the Kyrie Warrior. One at a time, roll the 20-sided die for each chosen figure.
• If the chosen figure is a Squad figure and you roll an 8 or higher, you may place the chosen figure onto a same-level space adjacent to Kilkorax.
• If the chosen figure is a Hero figure and you roll a 17 or higher, you may place the chosen figure onto a same-level space adjacent to Kilkorax.
Figures moved by Witchcraft Telekinesis never take leaving engagement attacks.

killian-vane.png.name: Killian Vane Iii
killian-vane.png.ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 3. All figures adjacent to the figure targeted by Blunderbuss Special Attack are also affected by Blunderbuss Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Killian Vane III cannot be affected by his own Blunderbuss Special Attack.

kita-the-springrunner.png.name: Kita The Springrunner
kita-the-springrunner.png.ability_1_desc: Figures must be within two spaces of Kita the Springrunner to target her with a normal or special attack.
kita-the-springrunner.png.ability_2_desc: Kita can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

knaves-of-the-silver-scimitar.png.name: Knaves Of The Silver Scimitar
knaves-of-the-silver-scimitar.png.ability_1_desc: At the start of the game, choose a Unique Captain you control to be the Knaves of the Silver Scimitar's Captain for this game. Knaves of the Silver Scimitar roll one additional defense die against attacks from non-adjacent figures when their chosen Captain is within 4 clear sight spaces.
knaves-of-the-silver-scimitar.png.ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Knaves of the Silver Scimitar, you may first take a turn with their chosen Captain or a Pirate Hero you control.
knaves-of-the-silver-scimitar.png.ability_3_desc: When attacking with a Knave of the Silver Scimitar, if the defending figure was not adjacent to that Knave of the Silver Scimitar at the start of this turn, that Knave of the Silver Scimitar receives 1 additional attack die.
knaves-of-the-silver-scimitar.png.ability_4_desc: Knaves of the Silver Scimitar are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

knight-irene.png.name: Knight Irene
knight-irene.png.ability_1_desc: Before moving Knight Irene, you may add 3 to her Move Value this turn. If you do, subtract 2 from her Attack Value this turn.
knight-irene.png.ability_2_desc: Range 1. Attack 3 + Special. You may attack twice with Overwhelm Special Attack. If you attack the same figure a second time, you may roll an additional attack die for the second attack. You may not use Overwhelm Special Attack if you used the Run Special Power this turn.

knights-of-weston.png.name: Knights Of Weston
knights-of-weston.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with the Knights of Weston, you may first take a turn with any Human Champion you control.
knights-of-weston.png.ability_2_desc: Knights of Weston roll one additional die against figures leaving an engagement with them.

kozuke-samurai.png.name: Kozuke Samurai
kozuke-samurai.png.ability_1_desc: Any or all Kozuke Samurai may add 3 to their Move number as long as they are unengaged prior to moving. Kozuke Samurai must be able to move adjacent to an opponent's figure in order to use Charging Assault.
kozuke-samurai.png.ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work against other Samurai.

kraken-master-png.png.name: The Kraken
kraken-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: The Kraken does not start the game on the battlefield. After revealing a numbered Order Marker on a Unique or Unfathomable Hero you control you may place 1 figure from this Squad that has not been destroyed on an empty space adjacent to that Hero.
kraken-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Once per round, instead of taking a turn with a Unique or Unfathomable Hero you control, you may take a turn with The Kraken instead.
kraken-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: Instead of moving normally with 1 of The Kraken's figures, you may place that figure on an empty space within 4 spaces of that figure. If it is engaged when it starts to Warp Space, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

krakenling-master-png.png.name: Krakenling
krakenling-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Instead of moving normally, you may place a Krakenling on an empty space within 4 spaces. If a Krakenling is engaged when it starts to Warp Space, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
krakenling-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: After moving normally, a Krakenling may switch spaces with an adjacent single-space figure. Figures moved by Eldritch Switch never take any leaving engagement attacks.
krakenling-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: A Krakenling may attack up to 3 times on its turn. Reduce the number of attacks by 1 for each Wound Marker it has.
krakenling-master-png.png.ability_4_desc: A Krakenling does not have to stop its movement when entering a water space.

krav-maga-agents.png.name: Krav Maga Agents
krav-maga-agents.png.ability_1_desc: When a Krav Maga Agent rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, one shield will block all damage.

krug.png.name: Krug
krug.png.ability_1_desc: When Krug attacks, he receives one extra attack die for each wound marker he has.
krug.png.ability_2_desc: When Krug attacks, he may attack one additional time.

kumiko.png.name: Kumiko
kumiko.png.ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Instead of moving and attacking normally with Kumiko, you may move Kumiko up to 3 spaces. Kumiko can attack up to 3 times with Ninjutsu Barrage Special Attack at any point before, during, or after this move as long as Kumiko is on a space where she could end her movement. Kumiko cannot attack the same figure more than once on a single turn.
kumiko.png.ability_2_desc: Kumiko can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

kurrok-the-elementalist.png.name: Kurrok The Elementalist
kurrok-the-elementalist.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Kurrok the Elementalist, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may, if possible, place one of your previously destroyed small or medium Elementals on an empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of Kurrok the Elementalist.
kurrok-the-elementalist.png.ability_2_desc: After revealing an order marker on Kurrok the Elementalist, instead of taking that turn with Kurrok, you may take a turn with up to three small or medium Elementals you control that are within 8 clear sight spaces of Kurrok the Elementalist.

kyntela-gwyn.png.name: Kyntela Gwyn
kyntela-gwyn.png.ability_1_desc: All friendly Elves adjacent to Kyntela Gwyn add 1 to their defense dice.

lady-jaye-advanced-png.png.name: Lady Jaye
lady-jaye-advanced-png.png.ability_1_desc: Start the game with 3 Zipline Glyphs on this card. Before and after moving normally, you may place up to 1 Zipline Glyph on an empty space within 1 clear sight space of Lady Jaye.
lady-jaye-advanced-png.png.ability_2_desc: The first time each turn that Lady Jaye is targeted for an attack by a Squad figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, Lady Jaye cannot be targeted by that attack or any other attacks this turn.

laglor-prototype.png.name: Laglor
laglor-prototype.png.ability_1_desc: All friendly figures with a range of 4 or more who follow Vydar and are within 4 clear sight spaces of Laglor add 2 spaces to their range. Vydar's Range Enhancement Aura does not affect Laglor.
laglor-prototype.png.ability_2_desc: Range 7. Attack 3. When attacking with Autoload Special Attack, you may roll Vydar Valkyrie dice. If you roll at least one Vydar symbol, you may attack again using Autoload Special Attack.

laglor.png.name: Laglor
laglor.png.ability_1_desc: All friendly figures with a Range number of 4 or more who follow Vydar and are within 4 clear sight spaces of Laglor add 2 to their Range number. Vydar's Range Enhancement Aura does not affect Laglor.
laglor.png.ability_2_desc: Range 7. Attack 3. When attacking with Autoload Special Attack, you may roll Vydar Valkyrie dice. If you roll at least one Vydar symbol, you may attack again using Autoload Special Attack.

loviatak-the-kyrie-warrior.png.name: Loviatäk The Kyrie Warrior
loviatak-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_1_desc: When a Squad figure you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Loviatäk the Kyrie Warrior attacks an adjacent figure with a normal attack, before defense dice are rolled, you may re-roll all attack dice that did not show skulls. Brutality Aura may only be used once per turn.
loviatak-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_2_desc: When attacking with Loviatäk, all skulls rolled count for one additional hit.
loviatak-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_3_desc: If you control Loviatäk and another Unique Kyrie Hero who follows Utgar, figures you control who follow Utgar increase their Move Value by 1.

lurking-hive-master-png.png.name: Lurking Hive Soldier
lurking-hive-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: If a Lurking Hive Soldier is targeted and would take 1 or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and that Lurking Hive Soldier. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 12 or higher, ignore those wounds.
lurking-hive-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: A Lurking Hive Soldier is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

macdirk-warriors.png.name: MacDirk Warriors
macdirk-warriors.png.ability_1_desc: At the start of the game, choose a Human Champion you control. While that champion is in play, MacDirk Warriors roll one additional attack die for each wound marker on the chosen hero. There can be only one Human Champion for all the MacDirk Warriors you control. MacDirk Warriors cannot attack their chosen Human Champion.
macdirk-warriors.png.ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the MacDirk Warriors, you may first take a turn with any Human Champion you control.

major-q10.png.name: Major Q10
major-q10.png.ability_1_desc: Range 7. Attack 2. Major Q10 may use this special attack 4 times in the same turn. Q10 may target the same figure or a different figure with each attack.
major-q10.png.ability_2_desc: Range 4. Attack 4. Major Q10 may use this special attack 2 times in the same turn. Q10 may target the same figure or a different figure with each attack.

major-q9.png.name: Major Q9
major-q9.png.ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 1, 2 or 3. Major Q9 starts each turn with 9 attack dice. Choose any figure within range and attack by rolling 1, 2 or 3 attack dice. Major Q9 may keep making special attacks with 1, 2 or 3 attack dice until he has rolled all 9 attack dice. Major Q9 may target the same or different figures with each attack.

major-x17.png.name: Major X17
major-x17.png.ability_1_desc: All small, medium or large opponent's figures that enter or occupy a space adjacent to Major X17 may not move. Figures affected by the Cyberclaw cannot be moved by any special power on an Army Card or glyph.
major-x17.png.ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, Major X17 adds 4 dice.

marachott-master-png.png.name: Marachott, Mind Whisperer
marachott-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Marachott, Mind Whisperer, before taking Marachott's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.
marachott-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: When rolling attack dice for a normal attack, Marachott always adds 2 automatic skulls to whatever is rolled.
marachott-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card and taking a turn with Marachott, you may choose a Unique Hero within 2 spaces of Marachott. Roll the 20-sided die, adding 3 to the roll if you control that Hero. If you roll a 16 or higher, take temporary control of that Hero and immediately take a turn with that Hero. After taking that turn, control of the chosen Hero returns to its previous owner. Any Order Markers that were on the chosen figure's Army Card stay on that card.

marcu-esenwein.png.name: Marcu Esenwein
marcu-esenwein.png.ability_1_desc: Each time Marcu Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Marcu Esenwein cannot Life Drain destructible objects.
marcu-esenwein.png.ability_2_desc: After revealing an order marker on this card, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, choose an opponent. That opponent will now control Marcu Esenwein for the remainder of your turn, but will not be able to view any unrevealed order markers on his card. At the end of that turn, control of Marcu returns to you. All order markers and figures that were on Marcu's Army Card will stay on his Army Card.
marcu-esenwein.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Marcu Esenwein's movement, ignore elevations. Marcu Esenwein may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Marcu Esenwein starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

marcus-decimus-gallus.png.name: Marcus Decimus Gallus
marcus-decimus-gallus.png.ability_1_desc: All Soldiers you control move one additional space.
marcus-decimus-gallus.png.ability_2_desc: All friendly Soldiers adjacent to Marcus Decimus Gallus receive an additional attack die.

marrden-hounds.png.name: Marrden Hounds
marrden-hounds.png.ability_1_desc: Before moving, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-3, add 1 to the move value of this card. If you roll a 4-6, add 3 to the move value of this card. If you roll a 7-20, add 7 to the move value of this card.
marrden-hounds.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to any Marrden Hounds you control. If you roll a 16 or higher, that figure receives a wound. Soulborgs and Wulsinu are not affected by this marro plague.

marrden-nagrubs.png.name: Marrden Nagrubs
marrden-nagrubs.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Marrden Nagrubs, you may first take a turn with any Hivelord you control. Before moving the chosen Hivelord, you may destroy one adjacent Marrden Nagrub you control. If you destroy a Marrden Nagrub with Hivelord Life Bonding, remove 1 wound marker from the chosen Hivelord's Army Card.
marrden-nagrubs.png.ability_2_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Marrden Nagrubs may double their Height.

marro-dividers.png.name: Marro Dividers
marro-dividers.png.ability_1_desc: When a Marro Divider you control receives one or more wounds from a Normal or Special Attack by an opponent's figure, you may roll the 20-sided die before removing that figure. If you roll a 17 or higher, ignore any wounds that figure just received and, if possible, place one of your previously destroyed Marro Dividers on a same-level space adjacent to the defending Marro Divider.
marro-dividers.png.ability_2_desc: Marro Hive cannot rebirth Marro Dividers with its Marro Rebirth special power.

marro-drones.png.name: Marro Drones
marro-drones.png.ability_1_desc: Before moving Marro Drones, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-12, you may move and attack with up to 3 Marro Drones you control. If you roll 13-16, you may move and attack with up to 6 Marro Drones you control. If you roll 17-20, you may move and attack with up to 9 Marro Drones you control.

marro-drudge.png.name: Marro Drudge
marro-drudge.png.ability_1_desc: When a Marro Drudge is on a swamp water space, add 1 to its attack and defense.
marro-drudge.png.ability_2_desc: If a Marro Drudge ends its normal movement on a swamp water space, you may immediately place it on any empty same-level swamp water space within 5 spaces. If a Marro Drudge is engaged when it starts to tunnel, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

marro-hive.png.name: Marro Hive
marro-hive.png.ability_1_desc: After revealing an order marker on this Army Card, you may take a turn with any small or medium common Marro Squad you control before taking a turn with Marro Hive. Any figure that is taking a turn must be within 12 clear sight spaces of Marro Hive prior to its movement.
marro-hive.png.ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Marro Hive, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, you may place any previously destroyed common Marro Squad figure from your army on an empty space adjacent to Marro Hive.

marro-stingers.png.name: Marro Stingers
marro-stingers.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-4, you must destroy a Marro Stinger you control and you cannot attack this turn. If you roll a 5-9, add 0 to the attack value of this card. If you roll a 10 or higher, add 1 to the attack value of this card.

marro-warriors.png.name: Marro Warriors
marro-warriors.png.ability_1_desc: Instead of attacking with all of the Marro Warriors, one at a time, roll the 20-sided die for each Marro Warrior in play. If you roll a 15 or higher, place a previously destroyed Marro Warrior on a same-level space adjacent to that Marro Warrior. Any Marro Warrior on a water space needs a 10 or higher to Water Clone. You may only Water Clone after you move.

master-of-the-hunt-155472.png.name: Master Of The Hunt
master-of-the-hunt-155472.png.ability_1_desc: After attacking an opponent's Unique Hero with this Master of the Hunt's normal attack, roll 1 attack die for each wound inflicted in that attack. For each additional skull rolled, place 1 additional wound marker on the defending figure's Army Card.
master-of-the-hunt-155472.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Master of the Hunt, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, add 3 to this Master of the Hunt's Range value for the duration of its turn.

master-of-the-hunt.png.name: Master Of The Hunt
master-of-the-hunt.png.ability_1_desc: After attacking an opponent's Unique Hero with this Master of the Hunt's normal attack, roll 1 attack die for each wound inflicted in that attack. For each additional skull rolled, place 1 additional wound marker on the defending figure's Army Card.
master-of-the-hunt.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Master of the Hunt, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, add 3 to this Master of the Hunt's Range value for the duration of its turn.

master-win-chiu-woo.png.name: Master Win Chiu Woo
master-win-chiu-woo.png.ability_1_desc: All Monk Squad figures you control may leap an additional 13 levels up or down when using their Stealth Leap special power. All Monks you control within 2 clear sight spaces of Master Woo add 1 to their attack dice and 1 to their defense dice.
master-win-chiu-woo.png.ability_2_desc: Master Woo may attack any or all figures adjacent to him. Roll each attack separately.
master-win-chiu-woo.png.ability_3_desc: Instead of his normal move, Master Woo may use Stealth Leap 25. Stealth Leap 25 has a move of 3. When counting spaces for Stealth Leap 25, ignore elevations. Master Woo may leap over water without stopping, leap over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. Master Woo may not leap more than 25 levels up or down in a single leap. If Master Woo is engaged when he starts his Stealth Leap 25, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

me-burq-sa.png.name: Me-Burq-Sa
me-burq-sa.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking, choose any small or medium figure within 6 clear site spaces of Me-Burq-Sa. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 16 or higher, the chosen figure cannot roll any defense dice if attacked by Me-Burq-Sa this turn.

mezzodemon-army-card.png.name: Mezzodemon Warmongers
mezzodemon-army-card.png.ability_1_desc: When a Mezzodemon Warmonger attacks a Common figure, add 1 to its Attack value.
mezzodemon-army-card.png.ability_2_desc: At the start of the game, place 1 copper Exoskeleton marker on a Mezzodemon Warmongers Army Card for each Mezzodemon Warmonger figure in your Army. After a Mezzodemon Warmonger rolls defense dice against a normal attack, you may remove 1 Exoskeleton marker from its Army Card to ignore all wounds inflicted by that attack.

microcorp-agents.png.name: Microcorp Agents
microcorp-agents.png.ability_1_desc: When a Microcorp Agent receives one or more wounds, before removing that agent, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, ignore any wounds.
microcorp-agents.png.ability_2_desc: Microcorp Agents do not have to stop their movement when entering a water space. Add 2 to a Microcorp Agent's defense while he is on a water space.
microcorp-agents.png.ability_3_desc: When a Microcorp Agent is attacking with a height advantage, he rolls an additional attack die.

mielki-the-kyrie-warrior.png.name: Mielki The Kyrie Warrior
mielki-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_1_desc: Once per turn, after attacking with Mielki the Kyrie Warrior, she may make one additional normal attack.
mielki-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_2_desc: When Mielki destroys a figure with a normal attack, you may choose a Small or Medium friendly figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Mielki. Remove a Wound Marker from the chosen figure. Mielki cannot heal herself with Spear of Sankari, and it cannot be used when destroying a destructible object.

migol-ironwill.png.name: Migol Ironwill
migol-ironwill.png.ability_1_desc: When attacking with Migol Ironwill, each skull rolled counts as one additional hit.
migol-ironwill.png.ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice, if Migol Ironwill rolls at least one shield, the most wounds Migol Ironwill can take for this attack is one.
migol-ironwill.png.ability_3_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Migol Ironwill may double his Height.

mika-connour.png.name: Mika Connour
mika-connour.png.ability_1_desc: If Mika Connour starts her turn unengaged and on a shadow space, add 3 dice to her attack this turn.
mika-connour.png.ability_2_desc: If Mika Connour starts her turn on a shadow space, instead of moving normally, you may place her on any other empty shadow space within 8 spaces of her current location. If Mika Connour is engaged when she starts her Shadow Dance, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
mika-connour.png.ability_3_desc: Mika Connour starts each game with up to 2 shadow tiles on her Army Card. If Mika Connour ends her turn on an empty land space, you may place a shadow tile from her Army Card onto the space she occupies if the shadow tile fits normally onto that space.

mimring.png.name: Mimring
mimring.png.ability_1_desc: Range Special. Attack 4. Choose 8 spaces in a straight line from Mimring. All figures on those spaces who are in line of sight are affected by Mimring's Fire Line Special Attack. Roll 4 attack dice once for all affected figures. Affected figures roll defense dice separately.
mimring.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Mimring's movement, ignore elevations. Mimring may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Mimring starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

mind-flayer-mastermind-card.png.name: Mind Flayer Mastermind
mind-flayer-mastermind-card.png.ability_1_desc: Range 3. Attack 3. This Mind Flayer Mastermind does not need clear line of sight to attack with Psionic Blast Special Attack. If a figure receives 1 or more wounds from Psionic Blast Special Attack, remove one unrevealed order marker at random from that figure's Army Card (or cards if your opponent has more than one Common card for that figure).
mind-flayer-mastermind-card.png.ability_2_desc: When revealing an order marker on this Mind Flayer Mastermind, after taking this Mind Flayer Mastermind's turn, you may choose any Unique Hero figure within 4 clear sight spaces of this Mind Flayer Mastermind. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, take temporary control of the chosen Hero and immediately take a turn with that Hero. At the end of that turn, control of the chosen Hero returns to its previous owner. All order markers that were on the figure's Army Card will stay on the Army Card. Enslave does not affect Mind Flayers.

minions-of-utgar.png.name: Minions of Utgar
minions-of-utgar.png.ability_1_desc: Instead of taking a turn with the Minions of Utgar, you may take a turn with any Kyrie Warrior you control who follows Utgar.
minions-of-utgar.png.ability_2_desc: When attacking with Minions of Utgar all skulls rolled count for one additional hit.
minions-of-utgar.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Minions of Utgar's movement, ignore elevation. Minions of Utgar may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Minion of Utgar starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

misaerx-the-kyrie-warrior.png.name: Misaerx The Kyrie Warrior
misaerx-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_1_desc: Each time this figure destroys a figure, you may remove a Wound Marker from this Army Card. This figure cannot Life Drain destructible objects.
misaerx-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_2_desc: When Misaerx the Kyrie Warrior is destroyed, place this figure on the Army Card of a Unique Warrior Hero that follows Revna. That Hero now has Life Drain.

mohican-river-tribe.png.name: Mohican River Tribe
mohican-river-tribe.png.ability_1_desc: If a Mohican River Tribesman is engaged, add 1 to his attack dice and 2 to his defense dice.
mohican-river-tribe.png.ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with the Mohican River Tribe, if at least two Mohican River Tribesmen you control are engaged, you may immediately take a turn with one Unique Tribesman Hero you control.
mohican-river-tribe.png.ability_3_desc: If a Mohican River Tribesman you control is targeted and receives one or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and the Mohican River Tribesman. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 19 or higher, ignore any wounds the Mohican River Tribesman just received.

molten-crustaceans-master-png.png.name: Molten Crustaceans
molten-crustaceans-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Begin the game with three 1-hex lava field tiles and one 1-hex molten lava tile for every Squad of Molten Crustaceans in your Army. After a Molten Crustacean you control is destroyed by a normal attack or leaving engagement attack, you must roll the 20-sided die and place one of these tiles onto the space the figure occupied, if the tile fits normally on that space. If you roll a 19 or higher place a molten lava tile, if able. Otherwise place a lava field tile.
molten-crustaceans-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Molten Crustaceans are not affected by lava field or molten lava spaces, and do not have to stop their movement on molten lava spaces.
molten-crustaceans-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Molten Crustaceans may double their Height.

moltenclaw-army-card.png.name: Moltenclaw
moltenclaw-army-card.png.ability_1_desc:
Range 4 + Special. Attack 4.
Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose 4 spaces in a straight line from the targeted figure. All figures on those spaces that are within line of sight of Moltenclaw are affected by Burning Breath Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Moltenclaw is not affected by Burning Breath Special Attack.
moltenclaw-army-card.png.ability_2_desc: Moltenclaw never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and he does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.
moltenclaw-army-card.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Moltenclaw's movement, ignore elevations. Moltenclaw may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If Moltenclaw is engaged when he starts to fly, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

morgrimm.png.name: Mogrimm Forgehammer
morgrimm.png.ability_1_desc: If at least one order marker is on Mogrimm Forgehammer, you may add 3 to your initiative roll.
morgrimm.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Mogrimm Forgehammer, you may choose any opponent's figure within 5 clear sight spaces that is engaged with any other figure you control. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives 1 wound.
morgrimm.png.ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, Mogrimm Forgehammer always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

morsbane.png.name: Morsbane
morsbane.png.ability_1_desc: Start the game with 3 brown Negation Markers on this card. At the end of the turn, if you have at least 1 Negation Marker on this card, you may choose any opponent's unique figure within 6 clear sight spaces of Morsbane. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-15, nothing happens. If you roll a 16-19, place a Negation Marker on the chosen figure's Army Card. All of that figure's special powers are negated for the entire game. If you roll a 20, destroy the chosen figure.

nakita-agents.png.name: Nakita Agents
nakita-agents.png.ability_1_desc: When any Nakita Agent you control, or any figure you control that is adjacent to any Nakita Agent you control, is targeted for a normal attack from a non-adjacent opponent, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, all Nakita Agents you control, and all figures you control that are adjacent to those Nakita Agents, no longer have any visible hit zones for the duration of the targeting figure's turn.
nakita-agents.png.ability_2_desc: If an opponent's small or medium figure moves adjacent to a Nakita Agent, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the opponent's figure receives a wound. Figures may be targeted only as they move into engagement with a Nakita Agent.
nakita-agents.png.ability_3_desc: Before taking a turn with Nakita Agents, you may move 3 Gorillinators you control up to 7 spaces each.

ne-gok-sa.png.name: Ne-Gok-Sa
ne-gok-sa.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any unique figure adjacent to Ne-gok-sa. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 20, take control of the chosen figure and that figure's Army Card. You now control that Army Card and all figures on it. Remove any Order Markers on this card. If Ne-Gok-Sa is destroyed, you retain control of any previously Mind Shackled Army Cards.

necrotech-master-png.png.name: Necrotech Wraithriders
necrotech-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with the Necrotech Wraithriders, one at a time, each Wraithrider may choose an enemy Small or Medium figure within 3 clear sight spaces whose level is no more than 11 levels above that Wraithrider's level or 6 levels below that Wraithrider's level. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 9 or higher, place the chosen figure on any empty same-level space adjacent to that Wraithrider. Figures moved by Chain Grab do not take leaving engagement attacks. A figure can only be moved by Chain Grab once each turn.
necrotech-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: A Necrotech Wraithrider cannot move onto a space more than 2 levels above its level.

necrotech-reavers-master-png.png.name: Necrotech Reavers
necrotech-reavers-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Necrotech Reavers, you may first take a turn with an Eisenek Hero you control. If that Hero is Unique, you may only activate 1 Necrotech Reaver.
necrotech-reavers-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: At the start of the round, before placing Order Markers, you may replace 1 Necrotech Reaver you control with 1 of your destroyed Common Medium Eisenek Heroes.

necrotech-wraithriders.png.name: Necrotech Wraithriders
necrotech-wraithriders.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with the Necrotech Wraithriders, one at a time, each Wraithrider may choose an enemy Small or Medium figure within 3 clear sight spaces whose level is no more than 11 levels above that Wraithrider's level or 6 levels below that Wraithrider's level. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 9 or higher, place the chosen figure on any empty same-level space adjacent to that Wraithrider. Figures moved by Chain Grab do not take leaving engagement attacks. A figure can only be moved by Chain Grab once each turn.
necrotech-wraithriders.png.ability_2_desc: A Necrotech Wraithrider cannot move onto a space more than 2 levels above its level.

nerak-the-glacian-swog-rider.png.name: Nerak The Glacian Swog Rider
nerak-the-glacian-swog-rider.png.ability_1_desc: Nerak is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
nerak-the-glacian-swog-rider.png.ability_2_desc: All orc figures you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Nerak add 1 to their defense dice. Nerak's Orc Defensive Aura does not affect Nerak.
nerak-the-glacian-swog-rider.png.ability_3_desc: Add 1 to Nerak's attack and defense while on a snow space.

nilfheim.png.name: Nilfheim
nilfheim.png.ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 4. When Nilfheim attacks with his Ice Shard Breath Special Attack, he may attack 2 additional times. He cannot attack the same figure more than once.
nilfheim.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Nilfheim's movement, ignore elevations. Nilfheim may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Nilfheim starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

ninjas-of-the-northern-wind.png.name: Ninjas Of The Northern Wind
ninjas-of-the-northern-wind.png.ability_1_desc: If a Ninja of the Northern Wind is attacked with a normal attack and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die to disappear. If you roll 1-11, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 12 or higher, that Ninja of the Northern Wind takes no damage and instead may move up to 4 spaces. Ninjas of the Northern Wind can disappear only if they end their disappearing move not adjacent to any enemy figures.
ninjas-of-the-northern-wind.png.ability_2_desc: Ninjas of the Northern Wind can move through all figures.
ninjas-of-the-northern-wind.png.ability_3_desc: Ninjas of the Northern Wind are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

nuckelavee-master-png.png.name: Nuckelavee
nuckelavee-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Range Special. Attack 2 + Special. Choose 3 spaces in a straight line from this Nuckelavee. All figures on those spaces who are in line of sight are affected by Withering Breath Special Attack. Roll 1 additional attack die for each wound on the attacking Nuckelavee. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Affected figures roll defense dice seperately.
nuckelavee-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: The first time a Nuckelavee destroys a figure each turn, you may remove a Wound Marker from that Nuckelavee. Subsume Soul cannot be used on destructible objects.

oathbound_legionnaires_master-png.png.name: Oathbound Legionnaires
oathbound_legionnaires_master-png.png.ability_1_desc: At the start of the game, if you have the Oathbound Phalanx in your Army, then you may place any or all Oathbound Legionnaire figures on your Oathbound Phalanx Army Card instead of placing them normally. Instead of attacking with an Oathbound Legionnaire, if you control the Oathbound Phalanx and it is adjacent to that Legionnaire, you may place that Oathbound Legionnaire onto the Oathbound Phalanx's Army Card.
oathbound_legionnaires_master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Oathbound Legionnaires are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
oathbound_legionnaires_master-png.png.ability_3_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Oathbound Legionnaires may double their Height.

oathbound_phalanx_master-png.png.name: Oathbound Phalanx
oathbound_phalanx_master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with the Oathbound Phalanx, you may place any Oathbound Legionnaire figures you control from this Army Card onto any empty spaces adjacent to the Oathbound Phalanx. After revealing an Order Marker on the Oathbound Phalanx and after taking a turn with it, you may take a turn with any Oathbound Legionnaires you control.
oathbound_phalanx_master-png.png.ability_2_desc: When the Oathbound Phalanx would receive one or more wounds, you may remove an Oathbound Legionnaire figure from this Army Card and destroy it. If you do, ignore all wounds the Oathbound Phalanx would have received.
oathbound_phalanx_master-png.png.ability_3_desc:
Range 1. Attack 3.
You may attack once for each Oathbound Legionnaire figure on this Army Card. When attacking a Small or Medium figure with All As One Special Attack, if you roll a skull on every die, the defending figure cannot roll any defense dice and is immediately destroyed.

obsidian-guards.png.name: Obsidian Guards
obsidian-guards.png.ability_1_desc: Obsidian Guards never roll for molten lava damage or lava field damage and they do not have to stop on molten lava spaces.
obsidian-guards.png.ability_2_desc: When an Obsidian Guard is on a molten lava space it may add 2 to its range.
obsidian-guards.png.ability_3_desc: An Obsidian Guard on a water space rolls 2 fewer defense dice.

ogre-pulverizer.png.name: Ogre Pulverizer
ogre-pulverizer.png.ability_1_desc: When this Ogre Pulverizer attacks, it may attack one additional time.
ogre-pulverizer.png.ability_2_desc: When attacking with this Ogre Pulverizer, all excess shields rolled by the defending figure count as unblockable hits inflicted by the defending figure on this Ogre Pulverizer.

ogre-warhulk-card.png.name: Ogre Warhulk
ogre-warhulk-card.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Ogre Warhulk, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1–10, it may attack normally. If you roll an 11 or higher, instead of attacking normally, it must attack each figure adjacent to it, if possible. Roll each attack separately.
ogre-warhulk-card.png.ability_2_desc: When you roll the 20-sided die for a Treasure Glyph trap with this Ogre Warhulk, you must subtract 4 from your die roll.

omnicron-repulsors.png.name: Omnicron Repulsors
omnicron-repulsors.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each Soulborg figure adjacent to any Omnicron Repulsors you control. If the figure is a Squad figure and you roll a 13 or higher, destroy that figure. If the figure is a Hero figure and you roll a 16 or higher, that figure receives a wound. Omnicron Repulsors are not affected by Circuitry Overload.
omnicron-repulsors.png.ability_2_desc: When attacking a non-adjacent figure, all Soulborg figures you control who follow Jandar add 1 die to their attack if at least one Omnicron Repulsor you control is adjacent to the defending figure.
omnicron-repulsors.png.ability_3_desc: If an Omnicron Repulsor you control successfully defends against an attack by a Soulborg figure, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, the attacking figure must immediately end its turn and all order markers must be removed from its Army Card (or cards if your opponent has more than one Common Army Card for that figure).

omnicron-snipers.png.name: Omnicron Snipers
omnicron-snipers.png.ability_1_desc: When attacking with Omnicron Snipers, all skulls rolled count for one additional hit.

onshu-the-welkineye.png.name: Onshu The Welkineye
onshu-the-welkineye.png.ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 2. You may attack one additional time with Sonic Blast Special Attack.

ordo-borealis-master-png.png.name: Ordo Borealis
ordo-borealis-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: If an Ordo Borealis does not move on its turn, it may add 6 to its Range Value for the rest of that turn.

ornak-prototype.png.name: Ornak
ornak-prototype.png.ability_1_desc: If Order Marker 3 is placed on Ornak, then instead of taking that turn with Ornak, you may take a turn with up to 2 Unique Heroes you control who follow Utgar. Ornak cannot be one of the 2 Unique Heroes. Any Unique Hero that is taking a turn instead of Ornak must be within 8 clear sight spaces of Ornak prior to its movement.
ornak-prototype.png.ability_2_desc: When attacking with any Orc Warrior figures you control adjacent to Ornak, you may roll Utgar Valkyrie dice. Each Utgar symbol rolled counts for an additional skull.

ornak.png.name: Ornak
ornak.png.ability_1_desc: If Order Marker 1 is placed on Ornak, then instead of taking that turn with Ornak, you may take a turn with up to 2 Unique Heroes you control who follow Utgar. Ornak cannot be one of the 2 Unique Heroes. Any Unique Hero that is taking a turn instead of Ornak must be within 8 clear sight spaces of Ornak prior to its movement.
ornak.png.ability_2_desc: When attacking with any Orc Warrior figures you control within 2 clear sight spaces of Ornak, you may roll Utgar Valkyrie dice. Each Utgar symbol rolled counts for an additional skull.

othkurik.png.name: Othkurik The Black Dragon
othkurik.png.ability_1_desc:
Range 4. Attack 4.
Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose up to two other figures adjacent to the targeted figure to be affected by Acid Spray Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
othkurik.png.ability_2_desc: If Othkurik starts his turn unengaged and on at least one shadow or swamp water space, for this turn add 1 to Othkurik's movement and add 3 to his Attack value.
othkurik.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Othkurik's movement, ignore elevations. Othkurik may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If Othkurik is engaged when he starts to fly, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

otonashi.png.name: Otonashi
otonashi.png.ability_1_desc: If Otonashi starts her turn adjacent to any figure you control who has a tricky personality, she may move 4 additional spaces.
otonashi.png.ability_2_desc: Otonashi can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
otonashi.png.ability_3_desc: When attacking a figure who has a wild personality, Otonashi rolls 2 additional attack dice.

parmenio.png.name: Parmenio
parmenio.png.ability_1_desc: At the start of the game, you may choose any unique Army Card you control. For this game the chosen card's personality is disciplined, regardless of what is listed on the card.
parmenio.png.ability_2_desc: When an adjacent Sacred Band figure receives one or more wounds, roll the 20-sided die before removing that figure. If you roll a 15 or higher, ignore any wounds.

pelloth.png.name: Pelloth
pelloth.png.ability_1_desc: Range Special. Attack 3. Choose a Drow figure you control that is within 5 clear sight spaces of Pelloth and roll 3 attack dice. One at a time for each skull rolled, you may inflict 1 wound on any small or medium figure that is within 2 clear sight spaces of the chosen Drow figure. You may inflict more than 1 wound on a single figure using Lolth's Wrath Special Attack. Figures affected by Lolth's Wrath Special Attack cannot roll any defense dice. After attacking with Lolth's Wrath Special Attack, destroy the chosen Drow figure.
pelloth.png.ability_2_desc: If Pelloth is on a shadow space, opponents' figures must be adjacent to attack him with a normal attack.

phantom-knights.png.name: Phantom Knights
phantom-knights.png.ability_1_desc: A Phantom Knight adds 3 additional defense dice when rolling defense against a normal attack from a figure who is not adjacent.
phantom-knights.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Phantom Knight's movement, ignore elevations. A Phantom Knight may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a Phantom Knight is engaged when it starts to fly, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

protectors-of-ullar.png.name: Protectors Of Ullar
protectors-of-ullar.png.ability_1_desc: When attacking with a Protector of Ullar, roll 1 additional attack die for every wound that has been inflicted on the defending figure this turn by Protectors of Ullar you control.
protectors-of-ullar.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Protector of Ullar's movement, ignore elevations. A Protector of Ullar may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Protector of Ullar starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

quasatch-hunters.png.name: Quasatch Hunters
quasatch-hunters.png.ability_1_desc: When a Quasatch Hunter attacks, it may attack up to 2 additional times. A Quasatch Hunter cannot attack the same figure more than once per turn.
quasatch-hunters.png.ability_2_desc: When attacking a Soulborg figure, Quasatch Hunters receive one additional attack die.
quasatch-hunters.png.ability_3_desc: If a Quasatch Hunter begins its turn adjacent to an Evergreen Tree or Jungle Piece, it may move 2 additional spaces.

queen-maladrix-master-png.png.name: Queen Maladrix the Conqueror
queen-maladrix-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Queen Maladrix the Conqueror and before taking a turn with her, you may first take a turn with your Festering Honor Guard.
queen-maladrix-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Once per turn, after attacking with Queen Maladrix, she may make one additional normal attack.
queen-maladrix-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with Queen Maladrix, you may choose a Unique Hero adjacent to Queen Maladrix that does not have a Festering Honor Guard on its Army Card and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 9 or higher, you may place one of your destroyed Festering Honor Guard on that Hero's Army Card.

queen-qhyrion.png.name: Queen Qhyrion
queen-qhyrion.png.ability_1_desc: Before attacking with Queen Qhyrion, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 12 or higher, a figure attacked by Queen Qhyrion may roll no more than 1 die for defense.

raakchott-steward-of-death.png.name: Raakchott, Steward Of Death
raakchott-steward-of-death.png.ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Raakchott, Steward of Death, before taking Raakchott's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.
raakchott-steward-of-death.png.ability_2_desc: Start the game with 3 red Consume Markers. When a figure within 3 clear sight spaces of Raakchott is destroyed, place a Consume Marker on this Army Card. You cannot place more than one Consume Marker on this card each turn.
raakchott-steward-of-death.png.ability_3_desc: Range 1. Attack 2 + Special. All figures adjacent to Raakchott are affected by Soul Fury Special Attack. Add 1 to Raakchott's attack dice for each Consume Marker on this Army Card. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Do not place Consume Markers on this Army Card while using Soul Fury Special Attack. After using Soul Fury Special Attack, remove one Consume Marker from this Army Card for each figure you attacked this turn.

raelin-bt-master-png.png.name: Raelin The Kyrie Warrior
raelin-bt-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Other players cannot gain control of, move, or take turns with Raelin the Kyrie Warrior.
raelin-bt-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Raelin may attack any number of times during her turn. She cannot attack any figure more than once per turn.
raelin-bt-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: Once per turn, after another figure you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Raelin defends against a normal attack from an enemy figure, if they received 1 or more wounds, you may place Raelin on an unoccupied space adjacent to the attacking figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 8 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Raelin does not take leaving engagement attacks when moved by Vengeful Swoop.

raelin-the-kyrie-warrior-sotm.png.name: Raelin The Kyrie Warrior
raelin-the-kyrie-warrior-sotm.png.ability_1_desc: Raelin may attack any or all figures adjacent to her. Roll each attack separately.
raelin-the-kyrie-warrior-sotm.png.ability_2_desc: All figures you control within 6 clear sight spaces of Raelin add 1 to their defense dice. Raelin's Extended Defensive Aura does not affect Raelin.
raelin-the-kyrie-warrior-sotm.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Raelin's movement, ignore elevations. Raelin may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Raelin starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

raelin-the-kyrie-warrior.png.name: Raelin The Kyrie Warrior
raelin-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_1_desc: While opponents' figures are within 4 clear sight spaces of Raelin the Kyrie Warrior, they lower their Defense Value by 1.
raelin-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_2_desc: If Raelin inflicts at least 1 wound with a normal attack or leaving engagement attack, she inflicts 1 additional wound.

ramosaur-master-png.png.name: Ramosaur Rider
ramosaur-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: When attacking with a Ramosaur Rider, if the defending figure was not adjacent to that Ramosaur Rider at the start of the turn, that Ramosaur Rider rolls 1 additional attack die.
ramosaur-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: After a Ramosaur Rider makes a normal attack, if there was an equal number of shields in the defense roll as skulls in the attack roll, Ramosaur Rider and the defender must each take 1 wound.

ranoc-master-png.png.name: Ranoc Vipers
ranoc-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: When a Ranoc Viper attacks an adjacent figure, the defender reduces its Defense Value by 1 for each skull in the attacking Viper's roll. Hypnosis does not affect destructible objects.
ranoc-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Ranoc Vipers increase their Defense Value by 2 when defending against a non-adjacent figure.
ranoc-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: Ranoc Vipers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.

rechets-of-bogdan.png.name: Rechets Of Bogdan
rechets-of-bogdan.png.ability_1_desc: Rechets of Bogdan do not start the game on the battlefield. They must be summoned onto the battlefield by Iskra Esenwein.
rechets-of-bogdan.png.ability_2_desc: When rolling attack dice against a small or medium figure, if a Rechet of Bogdan rolls a skull on every die, the defending figure cannot roll any defense dice and is immediately destroyed.
rechets-of-bogdan.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Rechets of Bogdan's movement, ignore elevations. Rechets of Bogdan may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Rechet of Bogdan starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

red-skull.png.name: Red Skull
red-skull.png.ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Red Skull's card, instead of taking that turn with Red Skull, you may take a turn with any Unique Hero you control within clear sight of Red Skull.
red-skull.png.ability_2_desc:
After moving and before attacking, you may either:
• Roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to Red Skull, or
• Roll the 20-sided die once for any one figure up to 3 clear sight spaces away.
If you roll a 19 or higher, that figure is destroyed.

red-wyrmling-card.png.name: Red Wyrmling
red-wyrmling-card.png.ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 3. Common Squad figures roll 2 fewer defense dice against Fledgling Fires Special Attack.
red-wyrmling-card.png.ability_2_desc: After revealing an order marker on a Red Wyrmling Army Card, before taking that Red Wyrmling's turn, you may take a turn with one other Wyrmling you control.
red-wyrmling-card.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for a Red Wyrmling's movement, ignore elevations. A Red Wyrmling may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a Red Wyrmling is engaged when it starts to fly, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

retiarius.png.name: Retiarius
retiarius.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, any small or medium figure attacked by Retiarius this turn may roll no more than 1 die for defense.

revenants-master-png.png.name: Revenants Of Revna
revenants-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on the Revenants of Revna, you may place a Wound Marker on a Warrior, Witch, or Scourge Hero you control who follows Revna. If you do, add 1 to the Attack Value of that Hero and all Revenants of Revna you control until the next time you reveal an Order Marker.
revenants-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Revenants of Revna, you may take a turn with a Warrior, Witch, or Scourge Hero you control who follows Revna.

revnan-acolytes-master-png.png.name: Revnan Acolytes
revnan-acolytes-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: While a Hero you control who follows Revna attacks with a normal attack or defends, if that Hero is adjacent to one or more Revnan Acolytes you control, you may re-roll 1 die.
revnan-acolytes-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: At the start of each round, before placing Order Markers, you may place one of your destroyed Revnan Acolytes onto an empty space adjacent to a Hero you control who follows Revna.

rhogar-dragonspire.png.name: Rhogar Dragonspine
rhogar-dragonspire.png.ability_1_desc: Range Special. Attack 3. Choose 3 spaces in a straight line from Rhogar Dragonspine. All figures on those spaces that are in line of sight are affected by Dragon Breath Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
rhogar-dragonspire.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Rhogar Dragonspine, you may choose a wounded friendly Hero figure adjacent to Rhogar Dragonspine and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 6 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from the chosen figure's Army Card.

roadblock-advanced-png.png.name: Roadblock
roadblock-advanced-png.png.ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 3. Roadblock may attack up to 3 times with Machine Gun Special Attack. He cannot attack the same target more than once each turn.

roman-archers.png.name: Roman Archers
roman-archers.png.ability_1_desc: Special Attack- Range 6, Attack 6. Three unengaged adjacent Roman Archers on the same level may combine their attacks and roll their attack dice as one attack. All Roman Archers in the arrow volley must have a clear line of sight on the one target.

roman-legionnaires.png.name: Roman Legionnaires
roman-legionnaires.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Roman Legionnaires, you may first take a turn with any Warlord you control.
roman-legionnaires.png.ability_2_desc: When defending with a Roman Legionnaire, add 1 defense die for each other adjacent Roman Legionnaire up to a maximum of +2 dice, for the Shield Wall power.

runa.png.name: Runa
runa.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking, Runa may use her Helm of Mitonsoul Aura. When using the Helm of Mitonsoul Aura, you must roll the 20-sided die for all figures within 3 clear sight spaces of Runa, one at a time. If you roll a 20, destroy the figure. Runa's Helm of Mitonsoul Aura does not affect Runa.
runa.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Runa's movement, ignore elevations. Runa may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Runa starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

sacred-band.png.name: Sacred Band
sacred-band.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Sacred Band, you may first take a turn with any Warlord you control who follows Einar.
sacred-band.png.ability_2_desc: If every Army Card you control has a disciplined personality, each soldier in the Sacred Band receives 1 additional defense die.

sahuagin-ranger.png.name: Sahuagin Raider
sahuagin-ranger.png.ability_1_desc: When attacking with a Sahuagin Raider, it receives 1 extra attack die for each wound marker on the defending figure's Army Card to a maximum of 3 additional attack dice for Blood Frenzy.
sahuagin-ranger.png.ability_2_desc: While a Sahuagin Raider is on a water space, add 2 to its Defense. If a Sahuagin Raider starts its turn on a water space, add 1 to its movement for that turn. A Sahuagin Raider does not have to stop its movement when entering a water space.

samuel-brown.png.name: Samuel Brown
samuel-brown.png.ability_1_desc: Range Special. Attack Special. If Samuel Brown begins his turn unengaged, instead of moving and attacking normally, he may use his Fire and Rush Special Attack. Choose a figure within 5 spaces of Samuel Brown to attack and roll 3 attack dice. If the defending figure receives one or more wounds from that attack, you may move Samuel Brown up to 5 spaces. If Samuel Brown ends that move engaged, he may attack again by rolling 4 attack dice.

saylind-the-kyrie-warrior.png.name: Saylind The Kyrie Warrior
saylind-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking, choose any figure you control on the battlefield, then roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-8, nothing happens. If you roll a 9-20, move the chosen figure to any space adjacent to Saylind. If the summoned figure is engaged, the figure does not receive any leaving engagement attacks.
saylind-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Saylind's movement, ignore elevations. Saylind may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Saylind starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

scarlett-advanced-png.png.name: Scarlett
scarlett-advanced-png.png.ability_1_desc: At the start of the round, after rolling Initiative, you may look at all unrevealed Order Markers on 1 enemy Army Card. Then you may move 1 Order Marker from a G.I. JOE or Soldier Army Card you control to another G.I. JOE or Soldier Army Card you control.
scarlett-advanced-png.png.ability_2_desc: When Scarlett makes an attack, the target figure lowers its Defense Value by 1 for every revealed Order Marker on its Army Card.
scarlett-advanced-png.png.ability_3_desc: Once per turn, after attacking, you may move Scarlett up to 2 spaces and make 1 normal attack against an adjacent figure.

scavorith-master-png.png.name: Scavorith, Lord Of Ruin
scavorith-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 3. When Scavorith, Lord of Ruin attacks with Double Burst Special Attack, he may attack 1 additional time, targeting the same or different figures with each attack.
scavorith-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Scavorith, you may reveal an "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to take 1 additional turn with Scavorith. You cannot use Double Burst Special Attack during this additional turn. If Scavorith does not attack a figure during the additional turn, Scavorith suffers 1 wound.

scions-master-png.png.name: Scions Of Icaria
scions-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: At the start of the game, choose an Archmage, Dragon, King, or Queen Unique Hero you control to be the Liege for all Scions of Icaria you control. Before taking a turn with the Scions of Icaria, you may take a turn with their chosen Liege.
scions-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Range 4. Attack 2. Only figures within 3 clear sight spaces of the Scions of Icaria's Liege can be targeted with Draconic Breath Special Attack.

sentinels-of-jandar.png.name: Sentinels Of Jandar
sentinels-of-jandar.png.ability_1_desc: When defending with Sentinels of Jandar, each shield rolled counts for one additional block.
sentinels-of-jandar.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Sentinels of Jandar's movement, ignore elevations. Sentinels of Jandar may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Sentinel of Jandar starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

sgt-drake-alexander-sotm.png.name: Sgt. Drake Alexander
sgt-drake-alexander-sotm.png.ability_1_desc: Opponents' figures must be adjacent to Sgt. Drake Alexander to attack him with a normal attack.
sgt-drake-alexander-sotm.png.ability_2_desc: Instead of his normal move, Sgt. Drake Alexander may use his Grapple Arm. Grapple Arm has a move of 4. When counting spaces for Grapple Arm, ignore elevations. Drake may grapple over water without stopping, over figures without becoming engaged, and over obstacles such as ruins. Drake may not grapple more than 45 levels up or down in a single Grapple Arm move. If Drake is engaged when he starts his Grapple Arm move, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.
sgt-drake-alexander-sotm.png.ability_3_desc: Range 5. Attack 3. Drake may not use Pistol Fire Special Attack to attack a figure who follows Jandar.

sgt-drake-alexander.png.name: Sgt. Drake Alexander
sgt-drake-alexander.png.ability_1_desc: Opponents' figures must be adjacent to Sgt. Drake Alexander to attack him with a normal attack.
sgt-drake-alexander.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Drake, you may choose one enemy Small or Medium figure within 4 clear sight spaces whose level is no more than 6 levels above or below Drake's level. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 8 or higher, place the chosen figure on any empty same-level space adjacent to Drake. If the chosen figure is engaged when it is moved by Grapple Grab, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

shades-of-bleakewoode.png.name: Shades of Bleakewoode
shades-of-bleakewoode.png.ability_1_desc: Before moving, each Shade of Bleakwoode you control may choose an adjacent unique hero. Roll the 20-sided die once for each Shade. If you roll 19 or 20, destroy the Shade of Bleakwoode figure, then take control of the chosen unique hero and remove any Order Markers on its card. You now control that Army Card.
shades-of-bleakewoode.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Shades of Bleakwoode's movement, ignore elevations. Shades of Bleakwoode may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Shade of Bleakwoode starts to fly, if it is engaged it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

shaolin-monks.png.name: Shaolin Monks
shaolin-monks.png.ability_1_desc: A Shaolin Monk may attack any or all figures adjacent to him. Roll each attack separately.
shaolin-monks.png.ability_2_desc: Instead of their normal move, any or all Shaolin Monks may Stealth Leap. Stealth Leap has a move of 3. When counting spaces for a Monk's leaping movement, ignore elevations. A Monk may leap over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. A Monk may not leap more than 12 levels up or down in a single leap. If a monk is engaged when he starts to leap, he does not take any leaving engagement attacks.

sharwin.png.name: Sharwin Wildborn
sharwin.png.ability_1_desc: Range 5 + Special. Attack 3. The first target of Arcane Bolt Special Attack must be within a Range of 5. After attacking with Arcane Bolt Special Attack, if the defending figure receives at least 1 wound, you may choose a figure that was adjacent to the defending figure at the beginning of that attack and attack that chosen figure with Arcane Bolt Special Attack. You may continue attacking with Arcane Bolt Special Attack in this manner until you fail to inflict a wound. A figure cannot be attacked more than once in a turn with Arcane Bolt Special Attack.
sharwin.png.ability_2_desc: When Sharwin Wildborn rolls defense dice against a normal attack, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure.
sharwin.png.ability_3_desc: When rolling attack dice for a normal attack, Sharwin Wildborn always adds 1 automatic skull to whatever is rolled.

shiori.png.name: Shiori
shiori.png.ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 2 + Special. If Shiori did not move normally, she may attack with Ninjutsu Mastery Special Attack up to three times. Before each attack, you must choose an opponent's figure with 2 clear sight spaces of Shiori and place Shiori on a empty space adjacent to that figure that is not more than 6 spaces higher or lower than Shiori's base. When attacking with Ninjutsu Mastery Special Attack, Shiori rolls 2 attack dice, or 3 attack dice if Shiori has exactly one unrevealed Order Marker on her Army Card.
shiori.png.ability_2_desc: If Shiori is attacked with a normal or special attack and receives 1 or more wounds, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, you may place Shiori on an empty space within 2 spaces of Shiori that is not more than 6 levels above or below Shiori's level. If you do, ignore all wounds just received.
shiori.png.ability_3_desc: Shiori can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

shurrak.png.name: Shurrak
shurrak.png.ability_1_desc:
Range 1. Attack 5.
Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to both Shurrak and the chosen figure are also affected by Sweeping Sword Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
shurrak.png.ability_2_desc: When a small or medium figure rolls defense dice and is not destroyed by a normal or special attack from Shurrak, immediately roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, you may Knockback the figure by placing it on any empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of Shurrak. The space must be on the same level as or lower than its current location. A figure moved by Knockback never takes any leaving engagement attacks. A non-flying figure moved lower by Knockback can receive any falling damage that may apply.
shurrak.png.ability_3_desc: Shurrak never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and he does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.

siege-card.png.name: Siege
siege-card.png.ability_1_desc: When revealing a numbered order marker on Siege's Army Card, you may also reveal an "X" order marker that is on Siege's Army Card to activate Crag of Steel for the duration of the round. While Crag of Steel is active, add 3 to Siege's Defense value and subtract 2 from Siege's Attack and Move values. When Siege attacks while Crag of Steel is active, he may attack any or all figures adjacent to him. Roll each attack separately.

silver-surfer.png.name: Silver Surfer
silver-surfer.png.ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for Silver Surfer's movement, ignore elevations. Silver Surfer may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Silver Surfer starts to fly, if he is engaged he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.
silver-surfer.png.ability_2_desc: Range 6. Attack 6. If an opponent's Unique Hero receives at least one wound from the Cosmic Force Blast Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may remove one unrevealed Order Marker at random from that Unique Hero's Army Card.
silver-surfer.png.ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with Silver Surfer, Silver Surfer may move up to an additional 5 spaces. Silver Surfer cannot use Hyper Speed 5 if he attacked with his Cosmic Force Blast Special Attack during that turn.

sir-denrick.png.name: Sir Denrick
sir-denrick.png.ability_1_desc: Sir Denrick rolls one additional die against each figure leaving an engagement with him.
sir-denrick.png.ability_2_desc: When Sir Denrick attacks huge figures, add 2 attack dice.

sir-dupuis.png.name: Sir Dupuis
sir-dupuis.png.ability_1_desc: Add 1 to Sir Dupuis' attack dice for every Knight you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Sir Dupuis up to a maximum of +3 dice.
sir-dupuis.png.ability_2_desc: When Sir Dupuis receives one or more wounds from a leaving engagement attack, immediately roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 7 or higher, ignore any wounds from that leaving engagement attack.
sir-dupuis.png.ability_3_desc: If Sir Dupuis has 4 or more wounds on his Army Card, add 1 to his defense dice.

sir-gilbert-prototype.png.name: Sir Gilbert
sir-gilbert-prototype.png.ability_1_desc: After you take a turn with Sir Gilbert, roll 12 Jandar Valkyrie dice. You may move up to 4 squad figures you control who follow Jandar up to X spaces. X equals the number of Jandar symbols rolled. Any squad figures moved with Jandar's Dispatch must be within 8 clear sight spaces of Sir Gilbert prior to moving.
sir-gilbert-prototype.png.ability_2_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to Sir Gilbert with a range of 1 add 1 die to their normal attack.

sir-gilbert.png.name: Sir Gilbert
sir-gilbert.png.ability_1_desc: After you take a turn with Sir Gilbert, you may roll 12 Jandar Valkyrie dice. Move up to 4 squad figures you control who follow Jandar up to X spaces. X equals the number of Jandar symbols rolled. Any squad figures moved with Jandar's Dispatch must be within 8 clear sight spaces of Sir Gilbert prior to moving.
sir-gilbert.png.ability_2_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to Sir Gilbert with a range of 1 add 1 die to their normal attack.

sir-glibert.png.name: Sir Gilbert
sir-glibert.png.ability_1_desc: After you take a turn with Sir Gilbert, you may roll 12 Jandar Valkyrie dice. Move up to 4 squad figures you control who follow Jandar up to X spaces. X equals the number of Jandar symbols rolled. Any squad figures moved with Jandar's Dispatch must be within 8 clear sight spaces of Sir Gilbert prior to moving.
sir-glibert.png.ability_2_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to Sir Gilbert with a range of 1 add 1 die to their normal attack.

sir-hawthorne.png.name: Sir Hawthorne
sir-hawthorne.png.ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. If Sir Hawthorne rolls at least 2 skulls with his Blind Rage Special Attack, Sir Hawthorne may attack again with his Blind Rage Special Attack. Sir Hawthorne may continue attacking with his Blind Rage Special Attack until he rolls fewer than 2 skulls.
sir-hawthorne.png.ability_2_desc: After you take a turn with Sir Hawthorne, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1, choose an opponent. That opponent now controls Sir Hawthorne. Remove any order markers on this Army Card, then give the card to that opponent.

skordyre-master-png.png.name: Skordyre Infantry
skordyre-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Skordyre Infantry, you may take turns with up to 2 Skordyre or Insect Common Heroes you control with different names or 1 Skordyre or Insect Unique Hero you control.
skordyre-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: After a Skordyre Infantry figure you control is destroyed by a normal attack from an enemy figure, you may move 1 unengaged Common Skordyre or Insect figure you control up to 5 spaces even if all of your Skordyre Soldiers are destroyed.
skordyre-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: When a Skordyre Infantry attacks a figure engaged with at least 2 other Skordyre or Insect figures you control, add 1 to its Attack Value.

snake-eyes-advanced-png.png.name: Snake Eyes
snake-eyes-advanced-png.png.ability_1_desc: Snake Eyes adds 2 to his Attack Value when attacking an enemy figure that is not adjacent to any other enemy figures.
snake-eyes-advanced-png.png.ability_2_desc: Snake Eyes increases his Defense Value by 2 when defending against a non-adjacent figure.
snake-eyes-advanced-png.png.ability_3_desc: Snake Eyes can move through all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.

sonlen-aoa-master-png.png.name: Sonlen
sonlen-aoa-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After moving normally with Sonlen, you may choose a figure with one or more wounds that is adjacent to Sonlen or that he passed over during his movement this turn and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, remove one Wound Marker from that figure.
sonlen-aoa-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: When Sonlen attacks an adjacent figure or destructible object, he may attack one additional time. If Sonlen used his Flying Special Power this turn, roll 1 additional Combat Die on the first attack.

sonlen.png.name: Sonlen
sonlen.png.ability_1_desc: Before moving, you may choose a wounded Hero figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Sonlen. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove one wound marker from the chosen Hero's Army Card. Sonlen's Dragon can use its Dragon Healing on Sonlen.
sonlen.png.ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Sonlen. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives one wound.

sonya-esenwein.png.name: Sonya Esenwein
sonya-esenwein.png.ability_1_desc: Each time Sonya Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Sonya Esenwein cannot Life Drain destructible objects.
sonya-esenwein.png.ability_2_desc: Anytime you roll the 20-sided die for Cyprien Esenwein's Chilling Touch, you may add 2 to your die roll.
sonya-esenwein.png.ability_3_desc: If you control Cyprien Esenwein and he is destroyed, Sonya Esenwein immediately receives 2 wounds.
sonya-esenwein.png.ability_4_desc: When counting spaces for Sonya Esenwein's movement, ignore elevations. Sonya Esenwein may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Sonya Esenwein starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

spartacus.png.name: Spartacus
spartacus.png.ability_1_desc: If all Order Markers for a round are placed on Gladiator Army Cards, and at least one Order Marker is placed on Spartacus, then all Gladiators you control (except Spartacus) become inspired. Inspired Gladiators add one to their Move number and add 1 extra attack die and defense die for the rest of the round.

spider-man.png.name: Spider-Man
spider-man.png.ability_1_desc: If Spider-Man is attacked by an opponent's figure and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-10, roll defense dice normally. If you roll an 11-20, Spider-Man takes no damage and may immediately move using his Swing Line 4 Special Power.
spider-man.png.ability_2_desc: Instead of a normal move, Spider-Man may use his Swing Line. Swing Line has a move of 4. When counting spaces for Spider-Man's Swing Line movement, ignore elevations. Spider-Man may swing over water without stopping, swing over figures without becoming engaged, and swing over obstacles such as ruins. Spider-Man may not Swing Line more than 40 levels up or down in a single Swing Line. If Spider-Man is engaged when he starts to Swing Line, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.
spider-man.png.ability_3_desc: Range 4. Attack 3. Figures roll 1 less defense die when defending against Spider-Man's Web Special Attack.

spitting-hive-master-png.png.name: Spitting Hive Soldier
spitting-hive-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After a Spitting Hive Soldier attacks a figure or destructible object, that figure or destructible object reduces its Defense Value by 1 until the next time any player reveals an Order Marker.

storm-shadow-advanced-png.png.name: Storm Shadow
storm-shadow-advanced-png.png.ability_1_desc: Start the game with 3 shadow tiles on this Army Card. At the end of Storm Shadow's turn, you may place a shadow tile from this card onto the battlefield within 3 clear sight spaces of Storm Shadow if the tile fits normally there.
