storm-shadow-advanced-png.png.ability_2_desc: Storm Shadow may attack any number of times during his turn. He cannot attack any figure more than once per turn.
storm-shadow-advanced-png.png.ability_3_desc: Storm Shadow can move through all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.

su-bak-na.png.name: Su-Bak-Na
su-bak-na.png.ability_1_desc: Anytime you roll the 20-sided die for a Marro or Wulsinu Army Card, you may add 1 to your die roll.
su-bak-na.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Su-Bak-Na's movement, ignore elevation. Su-Bak-Na may fly over water without stopping. Su-Bak-Na may pass over figures without becoming engaged. Su-Bak-Na may fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Su-Bak-Na starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

sudema.png.name: Sudema
sudema.png.ability_1_desc: Instead of attacking, choose any figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Sudema. Roll the 20-sided die. If the chosen figure is a Squad figure and you roll a 7 or higher, destroy it. If the chosen figure is a Hero figure and you roll a 17 or higher, destroy the chosen Hero.

sujoah.png.name: Sujoah
sujoah.png.ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. If Sujoah inflicts at least 1 wound with Poison Sting Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die for Poison Damage. If you roll 1-9, the defending figure receives no additional wounds for Poison Damage. If you roll 10-19, add 1 additional wound marker to the defending figure's Army Card, and roll again for Poison Damage. If you roll a 20, destroy the defending figure.
sujoah.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Sujoah's movement, ignore elevations. Sujoah may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Sujoah starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

swog-rider.png.name: Swog Rider
swog-rider.png.ability_1_desc: Swog Rider is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
swog-rider.png.ability_2_desc: All friendly Orc Archers adjacent to a Swog Rider receive an additional attack die and an additional defense die.

syvarris-aoa-master-png.png.name: Syvarris
syvarris-aoa-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking, you may reduce Syvarris' Range Value to 6 to make up to 2 normal attacks this turn. Or, you may reduce it to 3 to make up to 3 normal attacks this turn.

syvarris.png.name: Syvarris
syvarris.png.ability_1_desc: When Syvarris attacks, he may attack one additional time.

taelord-the-kyrie-warrior.png.name: Taelord The Kyrie Warrior
taelord-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_1_desc: All figures you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Taelord get +1 to attack. Taelord's Attack Aura does not effect Taelord.
taelord-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Taelord's movement, ignore elevations. Taelord may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins.

tagawa-samurai-archers.png.name: Tagawa Samurai Archers
tagawa-samurai-archers.png.ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work against other Samurai.

tagawa-samurai.png.name: Tagawa Samurai
tagawa-samurai.png.ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work against other Samurai.
tagawa-samurai.png.ability_2_desc: For every opponent's figure a Tagawa Samurai destroys, place a purple Experience Marker on this card. When attacking with Tagawa Samurai, roll one additional attack die for each Experience Marker on this card. A maximum of 3 Experience Markers can be placed on this card.

tandros-kreel.png.name: Tandros Kreel
tandros-kreel.png.ability_1_desc: If Tandros Kreel is attacking an adjacent figure, add 2 dice to Tandros Kreel's attack.
tandros-kreel.png.ability_2_desc: When Tandros Kreel attacks an adjacent figure, you may choose one Squad figure that is also adjacent to Tandros Kreel. If the defending figure receives any wounds from Tandros Kreel's attack, the chosen figure receives 1 wound.
tandros-kreel.png.ability_3_desc: If an opponent's figure that is adjacent to Tandros Kreel attacks with a normal or special attack, it must attack Tandros Kreel.

tanuki-master-png.png.name: Tanuki Tricksters
tanuki-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Before attacking with a Tanuki Trickster, you may choose an adjacent enemy Small or Medium figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 9 or higher, you may move the chosen figure 1 space. Tanuki Tricksters never make leaving engagement attacks against figures moved by Nage-Waza.
tanuki-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card and taking a turn with the Tanuki Tricksters, you may move up to 2 Small or Medium Vorid or Ninja figures you control that did not move this turn up to 3 spaces each.
tanuki-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: Tanuki Tricksters can move through all figures and are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

tarn-viking-warriors.png.name: Tarn Viking Warriors
tarn-viking-warriors.png.ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may move all Tarn Viking Warriors again.

templar-cavalry.png.name: Templar Cavalry
templar-cavalry.png.ability_1_desc: A Templar Cavalry Knight receives 2 additional attack dice when attacking any figure that was at least 4 clear sight spaces away from that Knight at the start of his turn.
templar-cavalry.png.ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against adjacent attacking small or medium Squad figures, Templar Cavalry Knights receive 1 additional defense die.
templar-cavalry.png.ability_3_desc: When attacking an opponent's figure who follows Utgar, Templar Cavalry Knights receive 1 additional attack die.

thanos.png.name: Thanos
thanos.png.ability_1_desc: At the start of each of your turns after Thanos has been destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 19 or higher, immediately place Thanos on a space adjacent to any figure you control and remove all Wound Markers on Thanos' card.
thanos.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Thanos' movement, ignore elevations. Thanos may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Thanos starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

the-axegrinders-of-burning-forge.png.name: The Axegrinders Of Burning Forge
the-axegrinders-of-burning-forge.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with The Axegrinders of Burning Forge, you may first take a turn with any Dwarf Hero you control. If you do not take a turn with any Dwarf Hero you control, add 2 to the Axegrinders' move number.
the-axegrinders-of-burning-forge.png.ability_2_desc: An Axegrinder of Burning Forge rolls an additional die when attacking or defending against large or huge figures.
the-axegrinders-of-burning-forge.png.ability_3_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, The Axegrinders of Burning Forge may double their Height.

the-einar-imperium.png.name: The Einar Imperium
the-einar-imperium.png.ability_1_desc: When each member of the Einar Imperium attacks, he may attack one additional time.
the-einar-imperium.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for the Einar Imperium's movement, ignore elevations. The Einar Imperium may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a member of the Einar Imperium starts to fly, if he is engaged he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

theracus.png.name: Theracus
theracus.png.ability_1_desc: Before moving Theracus, choose an unengaged friendly small or medium figure adjacent to Theracus. After you move Theracus, place the chosen figure adjacent to Theracus.
theracus.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Theracus's movement, ignore elevations. Theracus may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Theracus starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

thorgrim-the-viking-champion.png.name: Thorgrim the Viking Champion
thorgrim-the-viking-champion.png.ability_1_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to Thorgrim add 1 die to their defense.
thorgrim-the-viking-champion.png.ability_2_desc: When Thorgrim is destroyed, place this figure on any unique Army Card. Thorgrim's Spirit adds 1 to the defense number on that card.

thormun-master-png.png.name: Thormun
thormun-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with Thormun, you may place a gold Command Marker on the Army Card of another Hero you control to immediately take a turn with that Hero. You may not place a Command Marker on the Army Card of a figure with the same Affiliation as a Hero you control that already has a Command Marker. At the end of the round, remove all of your Command Markers.
thormun-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Thormun's Class is also Pirate, Captain, and King.
thormun-master-png.png.ability_3_desc: After attacking with Thormun, you may attack an adjacent figure 1 additional time. Thormun's Attack Value is increased by 2 for the second attack.

thyraxis-dragoon-master-png.png.name: Thyraxis Dragoon
thyraxis-dragoon-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Once per round, before taking a turn with the Thyraxis Dragoon, you may choose an enemy figure within 6 clear sight spaces of Thyraxis and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, you may look at one unrevealed Order Marker on that figure's Army Card. You may then choose any other figure controlled by the same player and move the Order Marker to that figure's Army Card.
thyraxis-dragoon-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: After attacking with Thyraxis Dragoon, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may attack again with Thyraxis.

tor-kul-na.png.name: Tor-Kul-Na
tor-kul-na.png.ability_1_desc: At any point while moving, Tor-Kul-Na may choose a small or medium figure that is adjacent, on the same level, and on a space where Tor-Kul-Na may end his movement. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-7, the figure is safe and Tor-Kul-Na's movement ends. If you roll 8-20, the chosen figure receives one wound. If the wound destroys the figure, move Tor-Kul-Na onto the space that figure occupied, and you may continue Tor-Kul-Na's movement. If the chosen figure is not destroyed, Tor-Kul-Na's movement ends. Tor-Kul-Na must be on a space where he can end movement each time he uses this power.

torin.png.name: Torin
torin.png.ability_1_desc: If Torin is attacking a small or medium figure, add 2 dice to Torin's attack.
torin.png.ability_2_desc: When Torin, or any friendly small or medium Utgar figure adjacent to Torin, rolls defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits inflicted by Torin on the attacking figure.

tornak.png.name: Tornak
tornak.png.ability_1_desc: Tornak is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
tornak.png.ability_2_desc: All friendly Orc Warriors adjacent to Tornak receive an additional attack die and an additional defense die.

tuck-harrigan-master-png.png.name: Wing Commander Tuck Harrigan
tuck-harrigan-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Tuck Harrigan does not start the game on the battlefield. If Harrigan has not been placed on the battlefield, before revealing a numbered Order Marker, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, place Harrigan on an empty space. You cannot place Harrigan adjacent to other figures. Then you may move any or all of your unrevealed Order Markers to this Army Card.
tuck-harrigan-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Harrigan increases his Defense Value by 1 when defending against a non-adjacent figure.

tul-bak-ra.png.name: Tul-Bak-Ra
tul-bak-ra.png.ability_1_desc: Range 3. Attack 3. Tul-Bak-Ra does not need clear line of sight to attack with Mind Blast Special Attack.
tul-bak-ra.png.ability_2_desc: Instead of moving Tul-Bak-Ra normally, you may choose any empty space that is on the same level and within 10 spaces of Tul-Bak-Ra. Place Tul-Bak-Ra on the chosen space. When Tul-Bak-Ra starts to Teleport, if he is engaged he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.
tul-bak-ra.png.ability_3_desc: When Tul-Bak-Ra receives one or more wounds from an opposing figure's Normal or Special Attack but is not destroyed, you may choose one friendly Marro Squad figure for every wound Tul-Bak-Ra just received. Place the chosen figure(s) on any empty space(s) adjacent to Tul-Bak-Ra. If the teleported figure(s) are engaged, they will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

ulginesh.png.name: Ulginesh
ulginesh.png.ability_1_desc: Instead of taking a turn with Ulginesh, you may take a turn with up to 2 different Elf Wizards you control. Ulginesh cannot be one of the 2 Elf Wizards. Any Elf Wizard that is taking a turn instead of Ulginesh must be within 6 clear sight spaces of Ulginesh before moving.
ulginesh.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Ulginesh's movement, ignore elevations. Ulginesh may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Ulginesh starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

valguard.png.name: Valguard
valguard.png.ability_1_desc: When attacking with Valguard, if the defending figure was not adjacent to Valguard at the start of this turn, Valguard receives 3 additional attack dice.
valguard.png.ability_2_desc: Add 1 to your die roll when you roll for the Berserker Charge power on any Army Card.

venoc-vipers.png.name: Venoc Vipers
venoc-vipers.png.ability_1_desc: Venoc Vipers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.
venoc-vipers.png.ability_2_desc: After you take a turn with Venoc Vipers, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher you may take another turn with Venoc Vipers.

venoc-warlord.png.name: Venoc Warlord
venoc-warlord.png.ability_1_desc: All scouts you control can move an additional 2 spaces.
venoc-warlord.png.ability_2_desc: Add 1 to your die roll when you roll for the Frenzy power on any Army Card.
venoc-warlord.png.ability_3_desc: Venoc Warlord does not have to stop his movement when entering water spaces.

venom.png.name: Venom
venom.png.ability_1_desc: If Venom is attacked by an opponent's figure and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-13, roll defense normally. If you roll a 14-20, Venom takes no damage and instead may immediately move using his Swing Line 4 Special Power.
venom.png.ability_2_desc: Instead of a normal move, Venom may use his Swing Line. Swing Line has a move of 4. When counting spaces for Venom's Swing Line movement, ignore elevations. Venom may swing over water without stopping, swing over figures without becoming engaged, and swing over obstacles such as ruins. Venom may not Swing Line more than 40 levels up or down in a single Swing Line. If Venom is engaged when he starts to Swing Line, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.
venom.png.ability_3_desc: Range 4. Attack 3. Figures roll 1 less defense die when defending against Web Special Attack.

vorid-glide-strikers-master-png.png.name: Vorid Glide Strikers
vorid-glide-strikers-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: Vorid Glide Strikers do not start the game on the battlefield. Before revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card, you may place one Glide Striker from this card that has not been destroyed onto an empty space. You cannot place that figure adjacent to other figures. The placed figure cannot move normally this turn.
vorid-glide-strikers-master-png.png.ability_2_desc: Vorid Glide Strikers increase their Defense Value by 1 when defending against a non-adjacent figure.

vrono-master-png.png.name: Vrono The Brambletooth
vrono-master-png.png.ability_1_desc: If an enemy Small or Medium figure moves onto a space adjacent to Vrono the Brambletooth where that figure could end its movement, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 12 or higher, the figure ends its movement and lowers its Attack Value by 1 until the end of the current turn. If you roll an 18 or higher, the figure also receives one wound.

warden-816.png.name: Warden 816
warden-816.png.ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 5. The Evisceraxe Special Attack cannot be used on small figures.
warden-816.png.ability_2_desc: All Guards you control move one additional space.

warforged-soldiers-card.png.name: Warforged Soldiers
warforged-soldiers-card.png.ability_1_desc: When a Warforged Soldier you control attacks an opponent's small or medium figure, before rolling the attack dice, you may switch that Warforged Soldier with the defending figure. After switching spaces, the Warforged Soldier must continue that attack, if possible, and cannot attack any other figure this turn. Figures moved by Tactical Switch never take any leaving engagement attacks. An opponent's figure may be moved by Tactical Switch only once per turn.
warforged-soldiers-card.png.ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal or special attack, a Warforged Soldier always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

warriors-of-ashra.png.name: Warriors Of Ashra
warriors-of-ashra.png.ability_1_desc: When a Warrior of Ashra rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, one shield will block all damage.

water-elemental-card.png.name: Water Elemental
water-elemental-card.png.ability_1_desc: While a Water Elemental is on a water space, add 1 to its Attack and Defense.
water-elemental-card.png.ability_2_desc: If a Water Elemental ends its normal movement on a water space, you may immediately place it on any empty same-level water space within 5 spaces. If a Water Elemental is engaged when it starts its Water Tunnel, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

werewolf-lord-card.png.name: Werewolf Lord
werewolf-lord-card.png.ability_1_desc:
This Werewolf Lord starts the game with 3 green Lycanthropy markers on its Army Card. If an opponent's Unique Hero receives at least 1 wound from this Werewolf Lord, you may place a Lycanthropy marker on that figure's Army Card. For the duration of the game, that figure loses its Species, Class, and Personality. Instead, it has the following characteristics:
• Species: Hybrid
• Class: Hunter
• Personality: Tormented
Lycanthropy never affects Constructs, Lycanthropes, Soulborgs, and destructible objects.
werewolf-lord-card.png.ability_2_desc: After revealing an order marker on this Werewolf Lord, before taking this Werewolf Lord's turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may first take a turn with any Hybrid Hero in play. If you take a turn with an opponent's Hybrid Hero, you control that hero for the duration of its turn. At the end of its turn, control of the Hybrid Hero returns to its previous owner. All order markers that were on the figure's Army Card will stay on the Army Card.

white-wyrmling-card.png.name: White Wyrmling
white-wyrmling-card.png.ability_1_desc:
Range 5. Attack 2.
When a White Wyrmling attacks with its Fledgling Ice Shards Special Attack, it may attack 1 additional time. It cannot attack the same figure more than once this turn.
white-wyrmling-card.png.ability_2_desc: After revealing an order marker on a White Wyrmling Army Card, before taking that White Wyrmling's turn, you may take a turn with one other Wyrmling you control.
white-wyrmling-card.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for a White Wyrmling's movement, ignore elevations. A White Wyrmling may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a White Wyrmling is engaged when it starts to fly, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

wo-sa-ga.png.name: Wo-Sa-Ga
wo-sa-ga.png.ability_1_desc: When attacking a small, medium or large figure, if Wo-Sa-Ga inflicts at least 2 wounds, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, destroy the defending figure.
wo-sa-ga.png.ability_2_desc: Wo-Sa-Ga does not have to stop her movement when entering water spaces.

wolves-of-badru.png.name: Wolves Of Badru
wolves-of-badru.png.ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Wolves of Badru, you may first take a turn with any Darklord you control.
wolves-of-badru.png.ability_2_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Wolves of Badru may double their height.
wolves-of-badru.png.ability_3_desc: Range 3. Attack 5. A Wolf of Badru that moved but did not attack normally may use Pounce Special Attack. To pounce, choose a non-adjacent small or medium figure whose base is not higher or lower than 5 levels from the base of the attacking Wolf. If the figure is destroyed, immediately place the attacking Wolf on the space the figure occupied. If the figure is not destroyed, destroy the attacking Wolf.

wyvern-card.png.name: Wyvern
wyvern-card.png.ability_1_desc: While this Wyvern is flying, you may choose one opponent's small or medium figure that it passed over this turn. Place the chosen figure on an empty same-level space adjacent to this Wyvern at the end of its move. If the chosen figure is engaged when it is moved by Talon Grab, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks. Figures under overhangs can never be moved by Talon Grab.
wyvern-card.png.ability_2_desc: When rolling attack dice, if this Wyvern rolls a skull on every die, the defending figure cannot roll any defense dice. Venomous Sting does not affect destructible objects.
wyvern-card.png.ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for a Wyvern's movement, ignore elevations. A Wyvern may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a Wyvern is engaged when it starts to fly, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

xenithrax-png.png.name: Xenithrax The Vineweaver
xenithrax-png.png.ability_1_desc: Xenithrax starts the game with three Xenithrax Vines Glyphs on this Army Card. Once per round, after moving and before attacking, Xenithrax may choose an empty space within 4 spaces of Xenithrax and place a Xenithrax Vines Glyph from this Army Card onto that space.
xenithrax-png.png.ability_2_desc: Range 5 + Special. Attack 4 - Special. The first target of Erupting Earth Special Attack must be within a range of 5. After attacking with Erupting Earth Special Attack, you may choose a figure that was adjacent to the defending figure at the beginning of that attack and attack that chosen figure with Erupting Earth Special Attack, rolling one fewer attack die. You may continue attacking with Erupting Earth Special Attack in this manner, rolling one fewer die than the previous attack, up to a total of four attacks. A figure cannot be attacked more than once in a turn with Erupting Earth Special Attack.

xenithrax-the-vineweaver.png.name: Xenithrax The Vineweaver
xenithrax-the-vineweaver.png.ability_1_desc: Xenithrax starts the game with three Xenithrax Vines Glyphs on this Army Card. Once per round, after moving and before attacking, Xenithrax may choose an empty space within 4 spaces of Xenithrax and place a Xenithrax Vines Glyph from this Army Card onto that space.
xenithrax-the-vineweaver.png.ability_2_desc: Range 5 + Special. Attack 4 - Special. The first target of Erupting Earth Special Attack must be within a range of 5. After attacking with Erupting Earth Special Attack, you may choose a figure that was adjacent to the defending figure at the beginning of that attack and attack that chosen figure with Erupting Earth Special Attack, rolling one fewer attack die. You may continue attacking with Erupting Earth Special Attack in this manner, rolling one fewer die than the previous attack, up to a total of four attacks. A figure cannot be attacked more than once in a turn with Erupting Earth Special Attack.

xiamara-the-kyrie-warrior.png.name: Xiamara The Kyrie Warrior
xiamara-the-kyrie-warrior.png.ability_1_desc: When a Kyrie you control who follows Ullar within 6 clear sight spaces of Xiamara the Kyrie Warrior receives one or more wounds, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8-16, ignore all but one wound just received. If you roll a 17 or higher, ignore all wounds just received. Amulet of Paivatar does not affect Xiamara.

zelrig.png.name: Zelrig
zelrig.png.ability_1_desc: Range 7. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the targeted figure are also affected by Majestic Fires Special Attack. Common Squad figures roll 2 less defense dice against Majestic Fires Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Zelrig cannot be affected by his own Majestic Fires Special Attack.
zelrig.png.ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Zelrig's movement, ignore elevations. Zelrig may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Zelrig starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

zetacron.png.name: Zetacron
zetacron.png.ability_1_desc: When attacking with Zetacron, each skull rolled counts for one additional hit.

zettian-guards.png.name: Zettian Guards
zettian-guards.png.ability_1_desc: When attacking, if your second Zettian Guard attacks the same figure as the first Zettian Guard, add one attack die to the second Zettian Guard's attack.

zombies-of-morindan.png.name: Zombies of Morindan
zombies-of-morindan.png.ability_1_desc: You may move up to 6 Zombies of Morindan that you control each turn. However, you may attack with only 3 Zombies of Morindan. You may attack with any 3 Zombies of Morindan, even Zombies of Morindan that you did not move this turn.
zombies-of-morindan.png.ability_2_desc: Range 1. Attack 6. Three Zombies of Morindan on the same level may combine their attacks and roll their attack dice as one attack. All Zombies of Morindan in the attack must be engaged to the targeted figure.
zombies-of-morindan.png.ability_3_desc: If a Zombie of Morindan that you control destroys an opponent's small or medium figure, replace that figure immediately, if possible, with one of your own previously destroyed Zombies of Morindan. Newly placed Zombies of Morindan cannot attack this turn. Undead are not affected by Zombies Rise Again.
